Kapau ʻoku tupu ʻi ha tangata pe ʻi ha fefine ʻae mahaki ʻi he ʻulu pe ʻi he kava;

‌ʻE mamata ai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he mahaki: pea vakai, kapau ʻoku hā mai ia ki lalo ʻi he kili; pea ʻoku ʻi ai ha tuʻoni fulufulu melomelo fuoiiki; ʻe toki fakahā ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia: ko e kamaa mōmoa ia, ʻio, ko e kilia ʻoe ʻulu pe ʻoe kava.

Pea kapau ʻoku mamata ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he mahaki ko e kamaa, pea vakai, ʻoku ʻikai hā mai ia ʻi lalo ʻi he kili, pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai ha fulufulu ʻuliʻuli; ʻe toki tāpuni[ki fale] ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻaia ʻoku mahaki ʻi he kamaa ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu:

Pea ʻe mamata ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻi hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho ki he mahaki: pea vakai, kapau ʻoku ʻikai totolo atu ʻae kama, pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻi ai ha fulufulu melomelo, pea ʻoku ʻikai matamata ʻi lalo ʻi he kili ʻae kama.
‌ʻE fafai ia ka ʻe ʻikai fafai ʻae kamaa pea ʻe toe tāpuni[ki fale] ʻa ia ʻoku kamaa ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu:

Pea ʻe mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki ki he kamaa ʻi hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho: pea vakai, kapau ʻoku ʻikai totolo ʻae kamaa ʻi he kili, pea ʻikai hā ʻi lalo ʻi he kili; ʻe toki fakahā ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻoku maʻa ia: pea ke fō ʻe ia hono ngaahi kofu, pea ʻe maʻa ai ia.
Pea kapau ʻoku totolo lahi ʻae kamaa ʻi he kili ʻoka hili hono fakamaʻa:
Pea ʻe mamata kiate ia ʻae taulaʻeiki pea vakai, kapau kuo totolo ʻae kamaa, ʻi he kili, ʻoua naʻa kumi ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he fulufulu melomelo; ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia.
Pea kapau ʻoku hā mai ʻae kamaa ʻoku pehē ai pe, pea kuo tupu ʻi ai ʻae fulufulu ʻuliʻuli; kuo moʻui ʻae kamaa, ʻoku maʻa ia: pea ʻe fakahā ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻoku maʻa ia.
Kapau ʻoku ʻi ha tangata pe ko e fefine ʻae ngaahi ʻila ngingila ʻi he kili ʻo honau sino, ʻio, ʻae ngaahi ʻila hinehina ʻoku ngingila;
Pea ʻe mamata ai ʻae taulaʻeiki pea vakai, kapau ʻoku hinehina ʻuliʻuli ʻae ngaahi ʻila ʻi hona sino; ko e ʻila ia ʻoku tupu ʻi hona sino; ʻoku maʻa ia.
Pea ko e tangata kuo mokulu hono louʻulu, kuo tula ia; ka ʻoku ne maʻa pe:
Pea ko ia kuo mokulu hono louʻulu mei hono muʻa laʻē ki ʻao, ko e tula muʻa laʻē ia; ka ʻoku ne maʻa.
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻi he ʻulu tula pe ʻi he muʻa laʻē tula ha meʻa pupula ʻoku hinehina kulokula; ko e kilia ia kuo tupu ʻi hono ʻulu tula pe ʻi hono muʻa laʻē tula.
Pea ʻe mamata ki ai ʻae taulaʻeiki pea vakai, kapau ʻoku hinehina kulokula ʻae meʻa kuo tupu ʻi hono ʻulu tula, pe ki hono muʻa laʻē tula, pea hā ia ʻo hangē ko e kilia ʻi he kili ʻoe sino:
Ko e tangata kilia ia, ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia; ʻe fakahā ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻoku taʻemaʻa ʻaupito ia; ʻoku ʻi hono ʻulu ʻa hono mahaki.

Pea ko e kilia ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae mahaki, ʻe haehae hono ngaahi kofu, pea ʻe tekefua hono ʻulu, pea ʻe ʻai ʻe ia ha meʻa ʻufiʻufi ki hono loungutu ʻi ʻolunga, pea ʻe kalanga ia, “Taʻemaʻa, taʻemaʻa.”
‌ʻE taʻemaʻa ia ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pē ʻo hono mahaki; ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia: ʻe nofo tokotaha ia; ʻe tuʻu ʻa hono nofoʻanga ʻi tuaʻā ʻi he ʻapitanga.
Ko e kofu foki ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mahaki ko e kilia, pe ko ha kofu sipi ia, pe ko e kofu tupenu tuʻovalevale;
‌ʻI hono lalanga fakamāukupu pe ʻi he lōloa: ʻi he tupenu, pe ʻi he kofu fulufuluʻi sipi; ko e meʻa ʻi ha kiliʻi manu, pe ʻi ha meʻa kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae kiliʻi manu;

Pea kapau ʻoku hangē ko e lanu ʻakau mata ʻae mahaki, pe kulokula ʻi he kofu, pe ʻi he kiliʻi manu, ʻi hono lalanga fakamāukupu pe ʻi hono lōloa, pe ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha he kiliʻi manu; ko e mahaki ia ko e kilia, pea ʻe fakahā ia ki he taulaʻeiki.
Pea ʻe mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki ki he mahaki, pea ʻe tāpuni [ki fale] ʻaia ʻoku mahaki ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu:

Pea ʻe mamata ʻe ia ki he mahaki ʻi hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho: pea kapau kuo totolo ʻae mahaki ʻi he kofu, ʻi hono lalanga fakamāukupu pe ʻi hono lōloa, pe ʻi ha kiliʻi manu, pe ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae kiliʻi manu; ko e kilia fakamamahi ia: ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia.
‌ʻE tutu ʻe ia ʻae kofu ko ia ʻaia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae kilia, ʻi hono māukupu pe ʻi hono lōloa, ʻi he kofu sipi, pe ʻi he tupenu, pe ʻi ha kiliʻi manu, he ko e kilia fakamamahi ia; ʻe tutu ia ʻi he afi.
Pea kapau ʻoku mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki, pea vakai, ʻoku ʻikai tupu ʻae mahaki ʻi he kofu, ʻi hono māukupu, pe ʻi hono lōloa, pe ʻi ha kiliʻi manu ʻe taha;
‌ʻE toki fekau ʻe he taulaʻeiki kenau fō ʻae meʻa ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mahaki, pea ke tuku tāpuni ia ke toe ʻaho fitu:

Pea ʻe mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki ki he mahaki, hili hono fō ia: pea vakai, kapau kuo ʻikai liliu ʻo mata kehe ʻae mahaki, pea ʻoku ʻikai totolo atu ʻae mahaki; ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia; ke ke tutu ia ʻi he afi; he kuo kai ia ʻi loto kuo molemole ia ʻi loto mo tuʻa.
Pea kapau ʻoku mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki, pea vakai, ʻoku mata ʻuliʻuli ʻae mahaki hili hono fō; pea ʻe hae ia mei he kofu, pe mei he kiliʻi manu, pe mei hono lōloa pe mei hono māukupu ʻoe kofu.
Pea kapau ʻoku kei hā ia ʻi he kofu, ʻi hono lōloa, pe ʻi he māukupu, pe ʻi ha kiliʻi manu ʻe taha: pehē ʻe toki tutu ʻaia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mahaki.
Pea ko e kofu, pe ko e lōloa pe māukupu, pe ko e kiliʻi manu ʻaia ʻoku ke fō, kapau ʻoku mahuʻi mei ai ʻae mahaki, pea ʻe toe fō ia ke liunga ua, pea ʻe maʻa ia.
Ko eni ʻae fono ki he mahaki ko e kilia ʻi he kofu sipi pe ko e tupenu, ʻi hono lōloa pe ʻi hono māukupu, pe ha kiliʻi manu ʻe taha, ke fakahā ai hono maʻa, pe fakahā ʻa hono taʻemaʻa.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Ko eni ʻae fono ki he kilia ʻi he ʻaho ʻo hono fakamaʻa: ʻE ʻomi ia ki he taulaʻeiki:
Pea ʻe ʻalu ʻae taulaʻeiki kituaʻā ʻi he ʻapitanga; pea ʻe mamata ʻae taulaʻeiki, pea vakai, pe kuo moʻui ʻae mahaki ko e kilia ʻi he kilia;
Pea ʻe toki fekau ʻe he taulaʻeiki ke toʻo maʻana ʻe ia ʻoku te u fakamaʻa, ʻae manu siʻi ʻe ua ʻoku moʻui mo maʻa, mo e ʻakau ko e sita, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e ʻisope:
Pea ʻe fekau ʻe he taulaʻeiki ke tāmateʻi ʻae manu ʻe taha ʻi ha ipu ʻumea ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he vaitafe.
Pea ko e manu moʻui, ʻe toʻo ʻe ia ia, mo e ʻakau ko e sita, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e ʻisope, pea ʻe unu ia mo e manu moʻui ki he toto ʻoe manu naʻe tāmateʻi ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he vaitafe,
Pea te ne luluku ʻaki ia ʻaia ʻoku fakamaʻa mei he kilia, ke liunga fitu, pea fakahā ʻoku maʻa ia, pea ʻe tukuange ʻae manu moʻui ke ʻalu ki he ʻataʻatā ʻoe fonua.

Pea ʻe fō ʻe ia ʻoku te u fakamaʻa ʻa hono ngaahi kofu, pea ʻe tekefua ia pea kaukau ia ʻi he vai, koeʻuhi ke maʻa ai ia: pea hili ia, ʻe haʻu ia ki he ʻapitanga, pea toe tatali mamaʻo mei hono fale fehikitaki ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu.

Pea ka hokosia ʻa hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho, ʻe tele ʻe ia ʻae louʻulu mei hono ʻulu kotoa mo hono kava, mo hono tuotua mata, ʻio, ʻe tele hono fulufulu kotoa pē: pea ʻe fō ʻe ia hono ngaahi kofu, pea kaukau mo hono sino ʻi he vai, pea ʻe maʻa ia.

Pea ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho te ne toʻo ʻe ia ha lami tangata ʻe ua taʻehaʻana-mele, mo e lami fefine ʻe taha ʻoe ʻuluaki taʻu taʻehanomele, mo e oma ʻe tolu ʻoe mahoaʻa lelei ko e feilaulau meʻakai, kuo fefiofi mo e lolo, mo e lolo ko e fua siʻi ʻe taha.
Pea ko e taulaʻeiki ʻoku ne fakamaʻa ia, ʻe ʻatu ʻe ia ʻae tangata ʻoku teu ke fakamaʻa mo e ngaahi meʻa ni, ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai:
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae lami tangata ʻe taha, ʻo ʻatu ia ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e fua siʻi ʻoe lolo, pea taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ia ko e feilaulau taʻaloʻalo ia kia Sihova:

Pea te ne tāmateʻi ʻae lami ʻi he potu ʻaia ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ai ʻae feilaulau maʻae angahala mo e feilaulau tutu, ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni: he ʻoku hangē ʻoku ʻoe taulaʻeiki ʻae feilaulau maʻae angahala, pea ʻoku pehē pe foki ʻae feilaulau maʻae fai hala: ko e meʻa māʻoniʻoni lahi ia:

Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae toto ʻoe feilaulau maʻae fai hala, pea ʻe ʻai ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ki he potu ʻi ʻolunga ʻoe telinga toʻomataʻu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa, pea ki he motuʻa nima ʻo hono nima toʻomataʻu, pea ki he motuʻa vaʻe ʻoe vaʻe toʻomataʻu:
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae lolo mei he fua siʻi ʻoe lolo, ʻo lingi ia ki he ʻaofi nima ʻo hono nima toʻohema ʻoʻona:
Pea ʻe ʻai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae tuhu ʻo hono nima toʻomataʻu ki he lolo ʻoku ʻi hono nima toʻohema, pea ʻe luluku ʻae lolo ʻaki hono tuhu ke liunga fitu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova:

Pea ʻe ʻai ʻe he taulaʻeiki, mei he toe ʻoe lolo ʻoku ʻi hono nima, ki he potu ʻi ʻolunga ʻoe telinga toʻomataʻu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa, pea ki he motuʻa nima ʻo hono nima toʻomataʻu, pea ki he motuʻa vaʻe ʻo hono vaʻe toʻomataʻu, pea ki he toto ʻoe feilaulau maʻae fai hala:
Pea ko hono toe ʻoe lolo ʻoku ʻi he nima ʻoe taulaʻeiki ʻe lingi ia ki he ʻulu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa: pea ʻe fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea ʻe ʻatu ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻo fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻaia ʻoku te u fakamaʻa taʻemaʻa: pea hili ia ʻe tāmateʻi ʻe ia ʻae feilaulau tutu:
Pea ʻe ʻatu ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae feilaulau tutu mo e feilaulau meʻakai ʻi he feilaulauʻanga: pea ʻe fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻe he taulaʻeiki, pea ʻe maʻa ai ia.

Pea kapau ʻoku masiva ia, pea ʻe ʻikai faʻa maʻu ʻe ia ha meʻa lahi pehē: ʻe toki toʻo ʻe ia ha lami ʻe taha pe ki he feilaulau maʻae fai hala, ke taʻaloʻalo ʻaki, ke fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana, mo e oma ʻe taha ʻoe mahoaʻa lelei kuo felingiʻaki ʻae lolo, ko e feilaulau meʻakai, mo e fua siʻi ʻe taha ʻoe lolo;
Mo e kulukulu ʻe ua, pe ko e lupe mui ʻe ua, ʻo hangē ko ʻene faʻa maʻu; pea ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala ʻae taha, pea ko e taha ko e feilaulau tutu.
Pea te ne ʻomi ia ki he taulaʻeiki ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho ʻo hono fakamaʻa, ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae lami ki he feilaulau maʻae fai hala, mo e fua siʻi ʻoe lolo, pea ʻe taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki ko e feilaulau taʻaloʻalo kia Sihova:

Pea ʻe tāmateʻi ʻe ia ʻae lami ki he feilaulau maʻae fai hala, pea ʻe toʻo ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae toto ʻoe feilaulau maʻae fai hala, ʻo ʻai ia ki he potu ʻi ʻolunga ʻoe telinga toʻomataʻu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa, pea ki he motuʻa nima ʻo hono nima toʻomataʻu, pea ki he motuʻa vaʻe ʻo hono vaʻe toʻomataʻu:
Pea ʻe lingi ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae lolo ki hono ʻaofinima toʻohema ʻoʻona:
Pea ʻe luluku ʻaki hono tuhu toʻomataʻu ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae toto ʻoku ʻi hono nima toʻohema ke liunga fitu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.

Pea ʻe ʻai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae lolo ʻoku ʻi hono nima ki he potu ʻi ʻolunga ʻoe telinga toʻomataʻu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa, pea ki he motuʻa nima ʻo hono nima toʻomataʻu, pea ki he motuʻa vaʻe ʻo hono vaʻe toʻomataʻu, ʻi he potu ʻoe toto ʻoe feilaulau maʻae fai hala:
Pea ko hono toe ʻoe lolo ʻoku ʻi he nima ʻoe taulaʻeiki ʻe lingi ʻe ia ia ki he ʻulu ʻo ia ʻoku fakamaʻa, ke fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea te ne ʻatu ʻe ia ha kulukulu ʻe taha, pe ha lupe mui, ʻo tatau mo ʻene faʻa maʻu;

Ko ia ʻoku ne faʻa maʻu, ko e taha ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala. Ko e taha ki he feilaulau tutu, mo e feilaulau meʻakai: pea ʻe fai ʻae fakalelei ʻe he taulaʻeiki maʻana, ʻaia ʻoku fai ke fakamaʻa ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Ko eni ʻae fono kiate ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mahaki ko e kilia, pea ʻoku ʻikai mafai ʻe hono nima ke maʻu ʻaia ʻoku kau ki hono fakamaʻa.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese mo ʻElone, ʻo pehē,
‌ʻOka mou ka hoko atu ki he fonua ko Kēnani, ʻaia ʻoku ou foaki kiate kimoutolu ke mou maʻu, peau ʻai ʻae mahaki ko e kilia ki ha fale ʻi homou fonua:
Pea ka haʻu ia ʻoku ʻoʻona ʻae fale ʻo tala ki he taulaʻeiki, ʻo pehē, ʻOku hā kiate au ʻo hangē ʻoku ai ʻae mahaki ko e kilia ʻi he fale:

‌ʻE toki fekau leva ʻe he taulaʻeiki kenau fetuku ʻae meʻa kotoa pē mei he fale ʻi he teʻeki hū ki ai ʻae taulaʻeiki ke mamata ki he mahaki, telia naʻa hoko ʻo taʻemaʻa ʻaia kotoa pē ʻoku ʻi he fale: pea ʻe toki ʻalu ki ai ʻae taulaʻeiki ke mamata ki he fale:
Pea te ne sio ki he mahaki, pea vakai, kapau ʻoku ʻi he ngaahi holisi ʻoe fale ʻae mahaki kuo matohitohi luoluo, pea lanu louʻakau mata, pe kulokula, ʻaia ʻoku matamata luoluo ʻi he[funga] holisi:
Pea ʻe toki ʻalu kituʻa fale ʻae taulaʻeiki ki he matapā ʻoe fale, pea tāpuni ʻae fale ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu:
Pea ʻe toe haʻu ʻae taulaʻeiki ʻi hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho, pea mamata: pea vakai, kapau kuo totolo ʻae mahaki ʻi he holisi ʻoe fale;
‌ʻE toki fekau ʻe he taulaʻeiki kenau toʻo ʻo ʻave ʻae ngaahi maka ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae mahaki, ʻo lī ia ki he potu taʻemaʻa ʻi tuaʻā ʻi he kolo:
Pea ʻe fekau ʻe ia ke teletele kotoa ʻae lahe ʻoe loto fale ʻo ʻosi, pea ke nau lilingi ʻae efu ʻoku nau teletele mei ai ki he potu taʻemaʻa ʻi tuaʻā ʻi he kolo:
Pea tenau toʻo ʻae ngaahi maka kehe ʻo ʻai ke fetongi ʻaki ʻae ngaahi maka ko ia; pea ʻe ʻomi ʻe ia ʻae lahe kehe, ke ʻaofi ʻaki ʻae fale:
Pea kapau ʻe toe haʻu ʻae mahaki ʻo tupu ʻi he fale, hili ʻa ʻene toʻo ʻo ʻave ʻae ngaahi maka, pea hili ʻa ʻene teletele ʻae fale, pea hili hono toe ʻaofi ia;
‌ʻE toki haʻu ʻae taulaʻeiki ʻo mamata, pea vakai, kapau ʻoku tupu ʻo totolo atu ʻae mahaki, ko e kilia tupu kovi ia ʻi he fale: ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia.
Pea ʻe holoki hifo ʻe ia ʻae fale, ʻa hono ngaahi maka, mo e ngaahi ʻakau ʻo ia, mo e lahe kotoa pē ʻoe fale; pea fetuku kotoa pē ia kituaʻā ʻi he kolo ki ha potu taʻemaʻa.
Pea ʻilonga ʻaia ʻe hū ki he fale ʻi he lolotonga ʻa hono tāpuni ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko ia ʻe mohe ʻi he fale ʻe fō ʻe ia hono ngaahi kofu; pea ko ia ʻoku kai ʻi he fale ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu.

Pea kapau ʻe haʻu ʻae taulaʻeiki, ʻo mamata ki ai, hili hono ʻaofi ʻae fale, pea vakai, ʻoku teʻeki totolo ʻae mahaki: pea ʻe toki fakahā ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻoku maʻa ʻae fale, koeʻuhi kuo mahuʻi ʻae mahaki.
Pea te ne toʻo ʻe ia ke fakamaʻa ʻae fale ʻae ʻuhikiʻi manupuna ʻe ua, mo e ʻakau ko e sita, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e ʻisope;
Pea te ne tāmateʻi ʻae manupuna ʻe taha ʻi he ipu ʻumea ʻi ʻolunga ʻi ha vai ʻoku tafe.

Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe ia ʻae ʻakau ko e sita, mo e ʻisope, mo e kulaʻahoʻaho, mo e manupuna moʻui, ʻo unu ia ʻi he toto ʻoe manu kuo tāmateʻi, pea ki he vai ʻoku tafe, pea ʻe luluku ʻaki ia ʻae fale ke liunga fitu:
Pea te ne fakamaʻa ʻae fale ʻaki ʻae toto ʻoe manu, mo e vai ʻoku tafe, pea mo e manu moʻui, mo e ʻakau ko e sita, pea mo e ʻisope, pea mo e kulaʻahoʻaho:
Ka ʻe tukuange ʻe ia ʻae manupuna moʻui mei he kolo ki he ʻataʻatā ʻoe fonua, pea fai ʻae fakalelei maʻae fale: pea ʻe maʻa ia.
Ko eni ʻae fono ki he mahaki kehekehe ʻoe kilia, mo e kamaa,
Pea ki he kilia ʻoe kofu, pea mo e fale,
Pea ki he hangatāmaki pupula, pea ki he mongumangu, pea ki he ʻila ngingila;
Ke fakahā ʻene taʻemaʻa mo ʻene maʻa; ko eni ʻae fono ʻoe kilia.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese mo ʻElone, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, ʻOka mahaki ʻae tangata ʻi he ʻau ʻa hono sino, ko ʻene ʻau ko ia ʻoku taʻemaʻa ai ia.
Pea ko hono taʻemaʻa eni ʻo ʻene ʻau; pe kuo ʻau hono sino ʻi heʻene mahaki, pē kuo matuʻu mei hono sino; ko ʻene taʻemaʻa ia.
Ko e mohenga kotoa pē ʻoku mohe ai ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau, ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia; pea ko e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku nofo ai ia, ʻoku taʻemaʻa ia.
Pea ko ia ʻe ala ki hono mohenga ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko ia ʻoku nofo ʻi ha meʻa naʻe nofo ai ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia, ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko ia ʻoku lave ki he sino ʻo ia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻaʻanu ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau kiate ia ʻoku maʻa; pea ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ʻilonga ha meʻa hekaʻanga ʻoku heka ai ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau ʻe taʻemaʻa ia.

Pea ko ia ʻe ala ki ha meʻa naʻe ʻi lalo ʻiate ia, ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi: pea ko ia ʻoku ne fua ʻae meʻa ko ia, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono ngaahi kofu, pea kaukau hono sino ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ʻilonga ʻaia ʻoku ala ki ai ʻaia ʻoku moʻua ʻi he mahaki ko e ʻau, pea naʻe ʻikai fanofano hono nima, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ia ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko e ipu ʻumea ʻoku ala ki ai ʻaia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau, ʻe foa ia: pea ko e ipu ʻakau kotoa pē ʻe fufulu ia ʻi he vai.
Pea ka fakamaʻa ia mei heʻene ʻau, ʻaia naʻe mahaki ai: ʻe toki lau kiate ia ʻae ʻaho ʻe fitu moʻono fakamaʻa, pea ʻe fō hono ngaahi kofu, pea kaukau hono sino ʻi he vai ʻoku tafe, pea maʻa ai.

Pea ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho ʻe toʻo ʻe ia kiate ia ʻae kulukulu ʻe ua, pē ko e lupe mui ʻe ua, pea ʻe haʻu ia ki he ʻao ʻo Sihova ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻo ʻatu ia ki he taulaʻeiki:
Pea ʻe ʻatu ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki, ko e taha ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, ko e taha kehe ko e feilaulau tutu; pea koeʻuhi ko ʻene ʻau ʻe fai ʻae fakalelei ʻe he taulaʻeiki maʻana ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻau noa mei he tangata hono huhuʻa fakatangata pea ʻe kaukau ʻe ia hono sino kotoa, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko e kofu kotoa pē, mo e kili kotoa pē, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae meʻa, ʻe fō ia ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko e fefine foki ʻaia ʻe mohe ki ai ʻae tangata, kena kaukau fakatouʻosi pe ʻi he vai, pea kena taʻemaʻa ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea kapau ʻoku mahaki ʻae fefine ʻi he ʻau, pea ko e mahaki ʻi hono sino ko e ʻau toto, ʻe tuku tokotaha ia ke ʻaho fitu: pea ko ia ʻe lave kiate ia ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku tokoto ki ai ia ʻi heʻene vaheʻi ʻe taʻemaʻa ia; pea ko e meʻa kotoa pē ʻoku nofo ki ai ia ʻe taʻemaʻa ia.
Pea ko ia ʻe ala ki hono mohenga, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono ngaahi kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ala ki ha meʻa naʻe nofo ki ai ia, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻi hono mohenga ʻae meʻa, pe ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻoku nofo ia ki ai, ʻi heʻene ala ki ai, ʻe taʻemaʻa ai ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea kapau ʻoku mohe ha tangata kiate ia, pea hoko hono mahaki kiate ia, ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu; pea mo e mohenga kotoa pē ʻoku mohe ai ia ʻe taʻemaʻa ia.

Pea kapau ʻoku mahaki ʻae fefine ʻi he ʻau ʻoe toto ʻi he ʻaho ʻoku lahi hake ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hono vaheʻi, pea kapau ʻoku fai ai pe ia hili ʻae ngaahi ʻaho ʻoe vaheʻi: ko e ngaahi ʻaho kotoa pē ʻo ʻene mahaki taʻemaʻa ʻe tatau pe ia mo e ngaahi ʻaho ʻo hono vaheʻi: ʻe taʻemaʻa ia.
Ko e mohenga kotoa pē ʻoku ne mohe ai ʻi he ngaahi ʻaho ʻo ʻene mahaki ʻe tatau ia kiate ia mo e mohenga ʻo hono vaheʻi: pea ko ia ʻe nofo ki ai ia ʻe taʻemaʻa, ʻo hangē ko e taʻemaʻa ʻo hono vaheʻi.
Pea ko ia ʻe ala ki he ngaahi meʻa ni, ʻe taʻemaʻa ia, pea ʻe fō hono kofu, pea kaukau ia ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi.
Pea kapau kuo fakamaʻa ia mei hono mahaki, ʻe toki lau ʻe ia kiate ia ʻae ʻaho ʻe fitu, pea hili ia, ʻe toki maʻa ia.
Pea ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho te ne toʻo ʻe ia ʻae kulukulu ʻe ua, pe ko e lupe mui ʻe ua, ʻo ʻomi ia ki he taulaʻeiki, ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.

Pea ʻe ʻatu ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae taha ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e taha ko e feilaulau tutu; pea ʻe fai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova koeʻuhi ko e mahaki ʻo ʻene taʻemaʻa.
Te mou vaheʻi pehē pe ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli mei heʻenau taʻemaʻa; telia naʻa nau mate ʻi heʻenau taʻemaʻa, ʻi heʻenau ʻuliʻi hoku fale fehikitaki ʻoku ʻiate kinautolu.
Ko eni ʻae fono ʻo ia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau, mo ia ʻoku ʻau noa meiate ia hono huhuʻa, pea ne taʻemaʻa ai.
Pea mo e[fefine] ʻoku mahaki ʻi hono mahaki, mo ia ʻoku ʻiate ia ʻae ʻau noa, pe ko e tangata, pe ko e fefine, pea mo ia ʻoku mohe kiate ia ʻoku taʻemaʻa.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova hili ʻae mate ʻae ongo foha ʻo ʻElone, ʻi heʻena fai ʻae feilaulau ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea na mate;

Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, “Lea ki ho taʻokete ko ʻElone, ke ʻoua naʻa faʻa haʻu ia ki he potu māʻoniʻoni ʻi he loto puipui ʻi he ʻao ʻoe nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa, ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he funga puha; telia naʻa mate ia: he te u fakahāhā au ʻi he nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa.
‌ʻE pehē ni ʻae haʻu ʻa ʻElone ki he potu māʻoniʻoni: ʻe ʻomi ʻe ia ʻae pulu mui ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e sipitangata ki he feilaulau tutu.”

Pea ʻe ʻai ʻe ia ʻae kofu tupenu hinehina māʻoniʻoni, pea ke ʻai ki hono sino ʻae kofu vaʻe tupenu hinehina, pea ke nonoʻo ʻaki ʻae noʻo tupenu hinehina, pea tatā ʻaki ʻae tatā tupenu hinehina: ko e ngaahi kofu māʻoniʻoni ʻeni; ko ia te ne kaukau ai hono sino ʻaki ʻae vai, pea ʻai ia [kiate ia].
Pea te ne toʻo ʻe ia mei he fakataha ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻae ʻuhikiʻi kosi ʻe ua ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e sipitangata ʻe taha ko e feilaulau tutu.
Pea ʻe ʻatu ʻe ʻElone ʻae pulu ki he feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻaia ʻoku maʻana, ʻo fai ʻaki ʻae fakalelei maʻana pea mo hono fale.
Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe ia ʻae ongo kosi, ʻo ʻatu ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai.
Pea ʻe fai ʻae talotalo ʻe ʻElone ki he ongo kosi: ke vahe ʻae taha maʻa Sihova, pea ko e taha ko e kosi fetuku.
Pea ʻe ʻomi ʻe ʻElone ʻae kosi naʻe talotalo ke vahe maʻa Sihova, ʻo ʻatu ia ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala.

Ka ko e kosi, ʻaia naʻe talotalo ke vahe ke hoko ko e kosi fetuku, ʻe ʻatu moʻui pe ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ke fai ʻaki ia ʻae fakalelei, pea ke tukuange ia ke ʻalu ki he toafa ngaongao ko e kosi fetuku.

Pea ʻe ʻomi ʻe ʻElone ʻae pulu ki he feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻaia ʻoku ʻatu maʻana, pea ne fai ʻaki ʻae fakalelei maʻana, pea mo hono fale, pea ʻe tāmateʻi ʻe ia ʻae pulu ʻoe feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻaia ʻoku ʻatu maʻana.

Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe ia ʻae ipu ʻaingaafi ʻoku fonu ʻi he malalaʻi afi vela mei he funga feilaulauʻanga ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea mo e falukunga lahi ʻoe meʻa namu kakala kuo tuki ke iiki, pea te ne ʻomi ia ki loto ʻi he puipui:

Pea ʻe ʻai ʻe ia ʻae meʻa namu kakala ki he afi ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, koeʻuhi ke ʻufiʻufi ʻe he kohu ʻoe meʻa namu kakala ʻae nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa, ʻaia ʻoku ne ʻufiʻufi ʻae fuakava, telia naʻa mate ai ia:

Pea ʻe toʻo ʻe ia mei he toto ʻoe pulu, ʻo luluku ʻaki hono tuhu ki he nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa ki he potu hopoʻangalaʻā; pea te ne luluku ʻae toto ʻi he ʻao ʻoe nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa ʻaki ʻa hono tuhu ke liunga fitu.

Pea te ne toki tāmateʻi ʻe ia ʻae kosi ki he feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻaia ʻoku maʻae kakai, pea ʻe ʻomi hono toto ki loto ʻi he puipui, pea ʻe fai ʻaki ʻae toto ʻo hangē ko ia naʻe fai ʻaki ʻae toto ʻoe pulu, ʻo luluku ia ki he nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa, pea ʻi he ʻao ʻoe nofoʻanga ʻaloʻofa:

Pea te ne fai ha fakalelei koeʻuhi ko e potu māʻoniʻoni, ko e meʻa ʻi he taʻemaʻa ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, pea ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau ngaahi talangataʻa mo ʻenau ngaahi angahala: pea ʻe fai pehē ʻe ia ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, ʻaia ʻoku tuʻu ʻiate kinautolu ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo ʻenau ngaahi meʻa taʻemaʻa.

Pea ʻe ʻikai ʻalu ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha ha tangata ʻe tokotaha, ʻoka hū ia ki ai ke fai ʻae fakalelei ʻoe potu māʻoniʻoni, kaeʻoua ke haʻu ia kituʻa, pea ʻosi ʻene fai ʻe ia ʻae fakalelei maʻana, pea mo hono fale, pea koeʻuhi ko e kakai kotoa pē ʻo ʻIsileli.

Pea te ne ʻalu kituʻa ki he feilaulauʻanga ʻaia ʻoku ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, pea fai ʻae fakalelei koeʻuhi ko ia; pea ʻe toʻo ʻae toto ʻoe pulu, mo e toto ʻoe kosi, pea ʻe ʻai ia ki he ngaahi nifo ʻoe feilaulauʻanga ʻo takatakai.
Pea te ne luluku ʻae toto ki ai ʻaki hono tuhu ke liunga fitu, ʻo fakamaʻa ia, ʻo fakatapui ia mei he ngaahi taʻemaʻa ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
Pea ʻoka hili ʻene fakaʻosi hono fakalelei ʻoe potu māʻoniʻoni, mo e fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, mo e feilaulauʻanga, ʻe toki ʻomi ʻe ia ʻae kosi moʻui:

Pea ʻe hilifaki ʻe ʻElone hono nima fakatouʻosi ki he ʻulu ʻoe kosi moʻui, ʻo vete ki ai ʻae ngaahi hia kotoa pē ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, mo ʻenau ngaahi talangataʻa kotoa pē, mo ʻenau ngaahi angahala, ʻo ne hilifaki ia ki he ʻulu ʻoe kosi, pea te ne fekau ke tataki atu ia ki he toafa ʻe ha tangata ʻoku ngalingali mo ia:
Pea ʻe fua ʻe he kosi ʻo ʻave ki he fonua lala, ʻenau ngaahi hia kotoa pē: pea te ne tukuange ʻe ia ʻae kosi ʻi he toafa.
Pea ʻe haʻu ʻa ʻElone ki he fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, pea toʻo hono ngaahi kofu tupenu hinehina, ʻaia naʻa ne ʻai ʻi heʻene ʻalu ki he potu māʻoniʻoni, pea te ne tuku ia ʻi ai:

Pea te ne kaukau ʻe ia hono sino ʻaki ʻae vai ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni, pea ʻai hono kofu, pea ʻalu atu, pea te ne ʻatu ʻae feilaulau tutu ʻaʻana, mo e feilaulau tutu ʻae kakai, ʻo ne fai ʻae fakalelei maʻana, pea mo e kakai.
Pea ko e ngako ʻoe feilaulau maʻae angahala ʻe tutu ʻe ia ia ki he feilaulauʻanga.
Pea ko ia naʻa ne tukuange ʻae kosi ko e kosi fetuku ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau hono sino ʻi he vai pea hili ia, ʻe haʻu ia ki he ʻapitanga.

Pea ko e pulu ki he feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e kosi ki he feilaulau maʻae angahala, ʻaia naʻe ʻomi hono toto ke fai ʻaki ʻae fakalelei ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni, ʻe fetuku ia kituaʻā ʻi he ʻapitanga: pea ʻe tutu ʻi he afi hona kili, mo hona sino, pea mo hona kinohaʻa.
Pea ko ia ʻoku fai ʻa hono tutu ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu, pea kaukau hono sino ʻi he vai, pea toki haʻu ia ki he ʻapitanga.

Pea ko e fekau tuʻumaʻu ʻeni kiate kimoutolu ʻo taʻengata: koeʻuhi ʻi hono fitu ʻoe māhina, ʻi hono hongofulu [ʻoe ʻaho] ʻoe māhina ke mou fakavaivai ʻakimoutolu, pea ʻoua naʻa fai ha momoʻi ngāue, pe ko ha tokotaha ʻo homou fonua pe ko ha tokotaha ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu.
Koeʻuhi ʻe fai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ke fakalelei maʻamoutolu, ke fakamaʻa ʻakimoutolu, koeʻuhi ke mou maʻa mei hoʻomou ngaahi angahala ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
‌ʻE ʻiate kimoutolu ia ko e Sāpate mālōlō, pea te mou fakavaivai ʻakimoutolu, ko e fekau ia fai maʻu ʻo taʻengata.

Pea ko e taulaʻeiki ko ia ʻaia kuo ne fakanofo, mo ne fakatapui ʻe ia ke ngāue ʻi he ngāue fakataulaʻeiki ʻo fetongi ʻene tamai, ʻe fai ʻe ia ʻae fakalelei, pea ʻe ʻai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi kofu tupenu hinehina, ʻio, ʻae ngaahi kofu māʻoniʻoni:

Pea ʻe fai ʻe ia ʻae fakalelei koeʻuhi ko e potu tapu lahi, pea fai ʻe ia ʻae fakalelei koeʻuhi ko e fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, pea koeʻuhi ko e feilaulauʻanga, pea ʻe fai ʻe ia ʻae fakalelei maʻae ngaahi taulaʻeiki, pea koeʻuhi ko e kakai kotoa pē ʻoe fakataha.

Pea ko e fekau fai maʻu eni ʻo taʻengata kiate kimoutolu, ke fai ʻae fakalelei maʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo tuʻo taha ʻi he taʻu koeʻuhi ko ʻenau ngaahi angahala. Pea naʻa ne fai ia ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea kia ʻElone, pea ki hono ngaahi foha, pea ki he fānau kotoa pē ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, Ko eni ʻae meʻa ʻaia kuo fekau ʻe Sihova, ʻo pehē,
Ko e tangata kotoa pē ʻiate kimoutolu ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ʻae pulu pē ko e lami, pe ko e kosi, ʻi he ʻapitanga, pe tāmateʻi ia ʻituʻa he ʻapitanga,

Pea ʻikai ʻomi ia ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, ke ʻatu ha feilaulau kia Sihova ʻi he ʻao ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻo Sihova; ʻe tuku ʻae toto ki he tangata ko ia: kuo lingi ʻe ia ʻae toto; pea ʻe motuhi ʻae tangata ko ia mei hono kakai:

Koeʻuhi ke ʻomi ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻenau ngaahi feilaulau, ʻaia ʻoku nau ʻatu ʻi he ngoue ʻataʻatā, ʻio, kenau ʻomi ia kia Sihova, ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, ki he taulaʻeiki, pea ke ʻatu ia ko e ngaahi feilaulau fakalelei kia Sihova.
Pea ʻe luluku ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae toto ki he feilaulauʻanga ʻo Sihova ʻi he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, pea tutu ʻae ngako ko e meʻa namu kakala kia Sihova.
Pea ʻe ʻikai tenau toe ʻatu ʻenau ngaahi feilaulau ki he ngaahi faʻahikehe, ʻaia naʻa nau holi kovi ki ai. Ko e fekau fai maʻu eni kiate kinautolu ʻo taʻengata ʻi honau ngaahi toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Pea te ke pehē kiate kinautolu, Ko e tangata ko ia ʻiate kimoutolu ʻi he fale ʻo ʻIsileli, pe ʻi he muli ʻoku nofo ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻoku ne ʻatu ha feilaulau tutu pe ha feilaulau,
Pea ʻoku ʻikai ʻomi ia ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe fakataha, ke ʻatu ia kia Sihova; ko e tangata ko ia ʻe motuhi mei hono kakai.

Pea ko e tangata kotoa pē ko ia ʻiate kimoutolu ʻi he fale ʻo ʻIsileli, pe ʻi he muli ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻoku kai ʻe ia ha toto: teu sio fakafulofula ki he tangata ko ia ʻoku kai toto, pea motuhi ia mei hono kakai.
He ko e moʻui ʻae kakano ko e toto pea kuo u tuku ia kiate kimoutolu ki homou feilaulauʻanga ke fai ʻae fakalelei maʻa homou laumālie; he ko e toto ʻoku ne fai ʻae fakalelei maʻae laumālie.
Ko ia naʻaku pehē ai ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻoua naʻa kai toto ʻe ha tokotaha ʻiate kimoutolu, pea ʻoua naʻa kai toto ʻe ha muli ʻe tokotaha ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu.

Pea ʻilonga ʻae tangata kotoa pē ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, pe ʻi he muli ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻaia ʻoku tuli pe maʻu ha manu ha manu kapakau ʻoku ngofua ke kai: ko e moʻoni ʻe lingi ʻe ia hono toto, ʻo ʻufiʻufi ʻaki ia ʻae efu.

He ko e moʻui ia ʻae kakano kotoa pē; ko hono toto ko ʻene moʻui ia; ko ia ne u pehē ai ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻoua naʻa mou kai ʻae toto ʻo ha meʻa moʻui ʻe taha: he ko e toto ko e moʻui ia ʻae kakano kotoa pē; ko ia ʻoku ne kai ia ʻe motuhi ia.

Pea ko ia ʻoku ne kai ʻaia naʻe mate mahaki, pē ko ia kuo haehae ʻe he manu, pe ko ha tokotaha ia ʻo homou fonua pe ko ha muli, ʻe fō ʻe ia hono kofu mo kaukau ia ʻi he vai, pea ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi: pea ʻe toki maʻa ia.
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai fō ia, pe kaukau hono sino; pea ʻe ʻiate ia pe ʻene hia.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, “Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.

‌ʻOua naʻa mou fai ʻo hangē ko e faianga ʻae fonua ko ʻIsipite, ʻaia naʻa mou nofo ai: pea ʻe ʻikai te mou fai ʻo hangē ko e faianga ʻae fonua ko Kēnani, ʻaia te u ʻomi ʻakimoutolu ki ai; pea ʻoua naʻa mou ʻalu ʻi heʻenau ngaahi fekau.
Ka mou fai ki heʻeku ngaahi fekau ʻo tauhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, ke fai ki ai; Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Ko ia ke mou tauhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, mo ʻeku ngaahi fekau; ʻaia kapau ʻe fai ia ʻe ha tangata, ʻe moʻui ai ia: Ko au ko Sihova.”
ʻOua naʻa ofi atu ha taha ʻiate kimoutolu ki ha tokotaha ʻoku kāinga moʻoni mo ia ko hono fakatelefuaʻi: Ko au ko Sihova.
Ko e telefua ʻo hoʻo tamai pe ko e telefua ʻo hoʻo faʻē ʻoua naʻa ke tatala: he ko hoʻo faʻē ia; ʻe ʻikai te ke fakatelefuaʻi ia.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae mali ʻo hoʻo tamai; he ko e telefua ia ʻo hoʻo tamai.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻa ho tuofefine ko e ʻofefine ʻo hoʻo tamai, pe ko e tama ʻo hoʻo faʻē, pe kuo ne tupu ʻi ʻapi, pe tupu ʻi he mamaʻo, ʻoua naʻa ke tatala honau telefua.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae ʻofefine ʻo ho foha, pe ko e tama ʻa ho ʻofefine; he ko honau telefua ko ho telefua ʻoʻou ia.
Pea ko e telefua ʻoe tama ʻae mali ʻo hoʻo tamai, kuo tupu ʻi hoʻo tamai, ko hoʻo tuofefine ia, ʻoua naʻa ke fakatelefua ia.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae tuofefine ʻo hoʻo tamai: he ko e kāinga fefine ofi ia ʻo hoʻo tamai.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae tokoua ʻo hoʻo faʻē: he ko e kāinga fefine ofi ia ʻo hoʻo faʻē.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae tokoua ʻo hoʻo tamai; ʻoua naʻa ke ʻunuʻunu ʻo ofi ki hono mali; he ko ho mehikitanga ia,
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻa ho ʻofefine ʻi he fono: he ko e mali ia ʻo ho foha; ʻoua naʻa ke fakatelefua ia.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae mali ʻo ho tokoua: he ko e telefua ʻo ho tokoua ia.

‌ʻOua naʻa ke fakatelefua ha fefine mo ʻene tama, pea ʻoua naʻa ke ʻave ʻae ʻofefine ʻo ʻene tama, pe ko e tama ʻa ʻene tama, ke fakatelefua ia; he ko hono kāinga fefine ofi ʻakinautolu; ko e meʻa kovi ia.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke mali mo e tokoua ʻo ho mali ke fakamamahi ʻaki ia, mo fakatelefua ia ʻi heʻene kei moʻui ʻaʻana.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke ʻunuʻunu ʻo ofi ki ha fefine ke fakatelefua ia, lolotonga kuo vaheʻi ia ʻi heʻene taʻemaʻa.
Pea ʻoua foki naʻa ke mohe angahala mo e uafi ʻo ho kaungāʻapi, ke fakaʻuliʻi koe mo ia.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke tuku ke ʻalu ʻa ho hako ʻi he afi kia Moleki, pea ʻoua naʻa ke fakaongokovi ʻae huafa ʻo ho ʻOtua; Ko au ko Sihova.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke mohe mo ha tangata ʻo hangē ko e mohe mo e fefine: ko e meʻa fakalielia ia.
Pea ʻe ʻikai te ke mohe mo ha manu ke fakaʻuliʻi koe ʻi ai: pea ʻoua naʻa tuʻu ha fefine ʻi he ʻao ʻoe manu ke tokoto ki ai: ko e meʻa kovi fakaʻulia ia.
‌ʻOua naʻa mou fakalieliaʻi ʻakimoutolu ʻi ha ngaahi meʻa pehē: he ʻoku ʻuliʻi ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ni ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga ʻaia ʻoku ou kapusi mei homou ʻao:
‌ʻOku fakalieliaʻi ʻae fonua: ko ia ʻoku ou totongi ki ai ʻene hia, pea ʻoku lua ʻaki foki ʻe he fonua ko ia ʻa hono kakai.

Ko ia te mou tauhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni mo ʻeku ngaahi fekau, pea ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻi he ngaahi meʻa fakalielia ni, ʻe ha tokotaha ʻi homou puleʻanga, pe ha muli, ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu.
(He ko e ngaahi meʻa fakalielia ni kuo fai ʻe he kau tangata ʻoe fonua, pea kuo pani ʻuli fōfō ʻae fonua:)
Telia naʻa lua ʻaki ʻakimoutolu foki ʻe he fonua, ʻo hangē ko ʻene lua ʻaki kituʻa ʻae ngaahi puleʻanga naʻe muʻomuʻa ʻiate kimoutolu.
He ko ia ʻe fai ha meʻa ʻi he ngaahi meʻa fakalielia ni, ʻio, ko e laumālie ʻe fai ia ʻe motuhi ia mei hono kakai.

Ko ia te mou tauhi ai ʻeku ngaahi fekau, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻi he ngaahi anga fakalielia ni, ʻaia naʻe fai ʻi muʻa ʻi homou ʻao, pea ke ʻoua naʻa mou ʻuliʻi ʻakimoutolu ʻi ai: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fakataha kotoa pē ʻoe fānau ʻa ʻIsileli mo ke pehē kiate kinautolu, “Ke mou māʻoniʻoni; he ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua ʻoku ou māʻoniʻoni.
“Te mou fakaʻapaʻapa taki taha kotoa pē ʻae tangata ki heʻene faʻē, mo ʻene tamai, pea tauhi hoku ngaahi Sāpate: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“ʻOua naʻa mou tafoki ki he ngaahi ʻotua loi, pea ʻoua naʻa mou ngaohi moʻomoutolu ʻae ngaahi ʻotua [ʻi he ukamea haka]: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“Pea kapau ʻoku mou ʻatu ʻae feilaulau ko e ngaahi feilaulau fakalelei kia Sihova, te mou ʻatu ia ʻi homou loto lelei ki ai.
‌ʻE kai ia ʻi he ʻaho ʻoku mou ʻatu ia, pea ʻi he ʻaho ʻoku na feholoʻi: pea kapau ʻoku ai hano toe ki hono ʻaho tolu, ʻe tutu ʻaki ia ʻae afi.
Pea kapau ʻe momoʻi kai ia ʻi hono ʻaho tolu, ko e meʻa kovi ia; ʻe ʻikai maʻu ia.
Ko ia, ko e tangata kotoa pē ʻoku kai ia ʻe ʻiate ia ʻene hia, koeʻuhi kuo fakahala ʻe ia ʻae meʻa tapu ʻa Sihova: pea ʻe motuhi ʻae tangata ko ia mei hono kakai.
“Pea ka mou ka tuʻusi ʻae fua ʻo homou fonua, ʻoua naʻa ke tuʻusi ke ʻosi ʻae ngaahi tuliki ʻo hoʻo ngoue, pea ʻe ʻikai te ke tānaki ʻae ngaahi toenga tufi ʻo hoʻo ututaʻu.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke tufi ʻae toenga ʻo hoʻo ngoue vaine, pea ʻoua naʻa ke tānaki ʻae kālepi kotoa pē ʻo hoʻo ngoue vaine; ka ke tuku ia ki he masiva mo e muli: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“ʻOua naʻa mou kaihaʻa, pe fai fakakākā, pe feloiʻaki ʻae taha ki he taha.
“Pea ʻoua naʻa mou fuakava loi ʻi hoku hingoa, pea ʻoua naʻa ke takuanoa ʻae huafa ʻo ho ʻOtua: Ko au ko Sihova.
“ʻOua naʻa ke kākaaʻi ho kaungāʻapi, pea ʻoua naʻa ke kaihaʻa meiate ia: ko e totongi ngāue ʻo ia naʻa mo alea ki ai, ʻoua naʻa tuku ia ʻiate koe ʻi he pō ʻo ʻaho.
“ʻOua naʻa ke kapeʻi ʻae tuli, pe ʻai ʻae tūkiaʻanga ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kui, ka ke manavahē ki ho ʻOtua: Ko au ko Sihova.
“ʻOua naʻa mou fai taʻetotonu ʻi he fakamaau: ʻoua naʻa ke tokanga koeʻuhi ko e mata ʻoe masiva, pe fakaʻapaʻapa koeʻuhi ko e mata ʻoe ʻeiki: ka te ke fakamaauʻi ho kaungāʻapi ʻi he angatonu.
“ʻOua naʻa ke feʻaluʻaki fano ke fetuku talanoa ʻi hoʻo kakai; pea ʻoua naʻa ke lea ke mate ai ho kaungāʻapi: Ko au ko Sihova.
“ʻOua naʻa ke fehiʻa ki ho tokoua ʻi ho loto: ko e moʻoni ke ke valokiʻi ho kaungāʻapi, pea ʻoua naʻa tuku ai pe ʻene angahala.
“ʻOua naʻa ke totongi kovi pe angafakamolokau ki he fānau ʻa ho kakai, ke ke ʻofa ki ho kaungāʻapi ʻo hangē pe ko koe: Ko au ko Sihova.

Te mou tauhi ʻeku ngaahi fekau. ʻOua naʻa ke tuku hoʻo fanga manu ke tauʻi ʻe he faʻahinga manu kehe: ʻoua naʻa ke tūtuuʻi hoʻo ngoue ʻaki ʻae ngaahi tenga kuo felavai; pea ke ʻoua naʻa ke ʻai ha kofu ʻoku felalangaʻaki ʻae filo tupenu mo e fulufuluʻi sipi.
“Pea ko ia ʻe mohe angahala mo e fefine ʻoku pōpula, kuo poloʻi ki ha mali, pea ʻoku teʻeki ai huhuʻi, pe tauʻatāina ia; ʻe haha ia; ʻe ʻikai tāmateʻi ʻakinaua, koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai ʻataʻatā ia.
Pea ke ʻomi [ʻe he tangata] ʻene feilaulau fai hala kia Sihova, ki he matapā ʻoe fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, ʻio, ko e sipitangata ki he feilaulau maʻae fai hala.

Pea ke fai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻae fakalelei maʻana ʻaki ʻae sipitangata ʻoe feilaulau maʻae fai hala ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻi heʻene angahala ʻaia kuo ne fai: pea ʻe fakamolemole kiate ia ʻae angahala kuo ne fai.
“Pea ka mou ka hoko atu ki he fonua pea mou tō ai ʻae ngaahi ʻakau kehekehe ki he kai, te mou lau hono ngaahi fua ko e meʻa tapu; ko e taʻu ʻe tolu ʻe tapu ia kiate kimoutolu; ʻoua naʻa kai ia.
Ka ʻi hono fā ʻoe taʻu ko e ngaahi fua kotoa pē ʻo ia ko e meʻa māʻoniʻoni ia ke fakafetaʻi ʻaki kia Sihova.
Pea ʻi hono nima ʻoe taʻu te mou kai hono ngaahi fua, koeʻuhi ke tupu ʻo fua lahi hake kiate kimoutolu: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“ʻOua naʻa mou kai ha meʻa ʻe taha mo hono toto: pea ʻoua naʻa mou fai tuki, pe fai ʻae talotalo kovi.
‌ʻOua naʻa mou kosi ke fuopotopoto homou louʻulu, pe maumauʻi hono potu tuliki ʻo hoʻomou kava.
‌ʻOua naʻa mou tafatafaʻi homou sino koeʻuhi ko e pekia, pea ʻoua naʻa mou tātatau; Ko au ko Sihova.
“ʻOua naʻa ke fakaangahalaʻi ho ʻofefine, pe fakahoko ia ko e fefine fai angahala; telia naʻa hinga ʻae fonua ki he feʻauaki, pea hoko ʻo fonu ʻae fonua ʻi he anga kovi.
“Te mou tauhi hoku ngaahi Sāpate, ʻo fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoku faletapu; Ko au ko Sihova.
“ʻOua naʻa tokanga kiate kinautolu ʻoku vaka ai ʻae kau laumālie ʻuli, pea ʻoua naʻa kumi ki he ngaahi taulafaʻahikehe tuki, ke mou ʻuli ai ʻiate kinautolu. Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“Ke ke tuʻu hake ʻi he ʻao ʻoe ʻuluhinā, ʻo fakaʻapaʻapa ki he mata ʻoe tangata motuʻa, pea manavahē ki ho ʻOtua; Ko au ko Sihova.
“Pea kapau ʻoku nofo ʻāunofo ha muli mo koe ʻi ho fonua, ʻoua naʻa ke fakamamahiʻi ia.

Ka ko e muli ʻoku nofo mo koe ʻe tatau ia mo e tokotaha kuo tupu ʻiate kimoutolu, pea te ke ʻofa kiate ia ʻo hangē ko hoʻo ʻofa kiate koe; he naʻa mou nofo ko e muli ʻi he fonua ko ʻIsipite; Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“ʻOua naʻa mou fai taʻetotonu ʻi he fakamaau, pe ʻi he meʻa fuofua pe ʻi he fakamamafa, pe ʻi he fakafuofua meʻa.
Te mou fua ʻaki ʻae meʻa fakatatau totonu, mo e fakamamafa totonu mo e efa totonu, mo e hini totonu: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻe ʻomi ʻakimoutolu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite.
Ko ia te mou tokanga ai ki heʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, mo ʻeku ngaahi fekau, ʻo fai ki ai. Ko au ko Sihova.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,

“Ko eni foki, ke ke lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, Ko ia fulipē ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, pe ʻi he kau muli ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻi ʻIsileli, ʻoku ne foaki hono hako kia Moleki; ko e moʻoni ʻe tāmateʻi ia: ʻe tolongaki ia ʻaki ʻae maka ʻe he kakai ʻoe fonua.

Pea te u fakahangatonu hoku fofonga ki he tangata ko ia, ke motuhi ia mei hono kakai: ko e meʻa ʻi heʻene foaki ʻa hono hako kia Moleki, ke ʻuliʻi hoku faletapu, mo fakaongokoviʻi hoku huafa māʻoniʻoni.
Pea kapau ʻoku fufū honau mata ʻe he kakai ʻoe fonua mei he tangata, ʻi heʻene foaki hono hako kia Moleki, pea ʻikai tāmateʻi ia;
Pea te u fakahanga hoku fofonga ki he tangata ko ia, pea ki hono fale, pea ko ia, mo kinautolu kotoa pē ʻoku fai hala ʻo muimui ʻiate ia, ke fai angahala mo Moleki, teu motuhi mei honau kakai.

“Pea ko ia ʻoku tafoki kiate kinautolu ʻoku vaka ai ʻae ngaahi laumālie ʻuli, mo e kau taulafakafaʻahikehe, ke ʻalu holi kovi kiate kinautolu, te u fakahanga moʻoni hoku fofonga ki he tangata ko ia, pea teu motuhi ia mei hono kakai.
“Ko ia mou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ʻakimoutolu, pea ke mou māʻoniʻoni: he ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Pea ke mou tauhi ʻeku ngaahi fekau ʻo fai ki ai: Ko au ko Sihova ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ʻakimoutolu.”
He ko ia kotoa pē ʻoku kapeʻi ʻene tamai pe ko ʻene faʻē, ko e moʻoni ʻe tāmateʻi ia kuo ne kapeʻi ʻene tamai pe ko ʻene faʻē pea ʻe ʻiate ia pe hono toto.
Pea ko e tangata ʻoku tonoʻi ʻae uafi ʻoe tangata ʻe tokotaha, ʻio, ko ia ʻoku tonoʻi ʻae uafi ʻo hono kaungāʻapi, ko e tangata tono fefine mo e fefine tono tangata, ʻe tāmateʻi moʻoni ʻakinaua.
Ko e tangata ʻoku mohe mo e mali ʻo ʻene tamai kuo fakatelefua ʻe ia ʻa ʻene tamai: ʻe tāmateʻi ʻakinaua fakatouʻosi pe; ʻe ʻiate kinaua hona toto.
Pea kapau ʻe mohe ʻae tangata mo hono ʻofefine ʻi he fono, ʻe tāmateʻi ʻakinaua fakatouʻosi pe: kuo na fai fakamaveuveu; ʻe ʻiate kinaua hona toto.
Pea kapau ʻe mohe ha tangata mo e tangata, ʻo hangē ko ʻene mohe mo e fefine, kuo na fai fakalielia fakatouʻosi pe; ke tāmateʻi moʻoni ʻakinaua; ʻe ʻiate kinaua hona toto.
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻomi ʻe ha tangata mo hono mali ʻae faʻē ʻa hono mali kena mali, ko e meʻa kovi ia: ʻe tutu ʻakinautolu ʻaki ʻae afi, ʻaia mo kinaua; koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa ai ha kovi ʻiate kimoutolu.
Pea kapau ʻe mohe ha tangata mo e manu, ʻe tāmateʻi moʻoni ia: pea ke mou tāmateʻi ʻae manu.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻunuʻunu atu ha fefine ki ha manu, pea tokoto ki ai ia, ʻe tāmateʻi ʻae fefine, mo e manu: ʻe tāmateʻi moʻoni ʻakinaua; ʻe ʻiate kinaua hona toto.

Pea kapau ʻe ʻave ʻe ha tangata hono tuofefine, ko e ʻofefine ʻo ʻene tamai, pe ko e tama ʻa ʻene faʻē, ʻo mamata ki heʻene telefua, pea mamata ia ki heʻene telefua ʻaʻana; ko e meʻa kovi ia: pea ʻe motuhi ʻakinaua ʻi he ʻao ʻo hona kakai: kuo tatala ʻo fakatelefua ʻa hono tuofefine; ʻe fua ʻe ia ʻene hia.

Pea kapau ʻe mohe ha tangata mo e fefine ʻoku ʻiate ia hono mahaki, pea tatala hono mahaki; kuo ne fakatelefua hono mahaki, pea kuo tatala ʻe ia ʻae mata ʻo hono toto: pea ʻe motuhi ʻakinaua fakatouʻosi mei hona kakai.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke fakatelefua ʻae tokoua ʻo hoʻo faʻē, pe ko e tuofefine ʻo hoʻo tamai: he ko ia ʻoku ne [fai pehē] ʻoku fakatelefua hono kāinga ofi: te na fua ʻena hia.
Pea kapau ʻe mohe ha tangata mo e uaifi ʻoe tokoua ʻo ʻene tamai, kuo fakatelefua ʻe ia ʻa hono tuʻasina: te na fua ʻena angahala: te na mate taʻehafānau.
Pea kapau ʻe maʻu ʻe ha tangata ʻae uaifi ʻa hono tokoua, ko e meʻa taʻemaʻa ia: kuo fakatelefua ʻa hono tokoua; te na mate taʻehafānau.
“Ko ia ke mou tauhi ai ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ni, mo ʻeku ngaahi fekau, ʻo fai ki ai: telia naʻa lua ʻaki ʻakimoutolu ʻe he fonua ʻoku ou ʻomi ʻakimoutolu ki ai.
Pea ʻe ʻikai te mou fai ki he ngaahi anga ʻoe puleʻanga, ʻaia ʻoku ou kapusi mei homou ʻao: he kuo nau fai ʻae ngaahi meʻa ni, pea ko ia kuo u fehiʻa ai kiate kinautolu.

Ka kuo u lea kiate kimoutolu, Te mou maʻu honau fonua, pea te u ʻatu ia kiate kimoutolu ke mou maʻu ia, ko e fonua ʻoku mahu tāfea ʻi he huʻahuhu mo e honi: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua, ʻaia kuo u vaheʻi ʻakimoutolu mei he kakai kehe.

Ko ia ke mou vaheʻi ʻae fanga manu maʻa mo e taʻemaʻa, pea lau kehe ʻae fanga manu taʻemaʻa ʻoku kapakau mo e maʻa: pea ʻoua naʻa mou fakalieliaʻi ʻakimoutolu ʻi he manu, pe ha manu kapakau, pe ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha ʻoku totolo ʻi he kelekele, ʻaia kuo vaheʻi ia ʻiate kimoutolu ko e taʻemaʻa.
Pea te mou māʻoniʻoni kiate au: he ko au Sihova ʻoku ou māʻoniʻoni, pea kuo u fakamavahe ʻakimoutolu mei he kakai kehe, koeʻuhi ke ʻoʻoku ʻakimoutolu.
“Ko e tangata foki, pe ko e fefine ʻoku vaka ai ʻae laumālie ʻuli, pea ko e taulafakafaʻahikehe, ʻe tāmateʻi moʻoni ia: ʻe tolongaki ʻakinautolu ʻaki ʻae maka: ʻe ʻiate kinautolu honau toto.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, Lea ki he kau taulaʻeiki ko e ngaahi foha ʻo ʻElone, ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, “ʻOua naʻa fakaʻuliʻi ha tokotaha koeʻuhi ko e pekia ʻoku ʻi hono kakai:
Ka koeʻuhi ko hono kāinga moʻoni, ʻoku ofi kiate ia, koeʻuhi ko ʻene faʻē, pea mo ʻene tamai, pea mo hono foha, pea mo hono ʻofefine, pea mo hono tokoua,
Pea koeʻuhi ko hono tuofefine ko e tāupoʻou, ʻaia ʻoku ofi kiate ia, pea kuo teʻeki ai hano husepāniti; ʻoku ngofua ʻene taʻemaʻa koeʻuhi ko ia.
Kaeʻoua naʻa ne fakaʻuliʻi ia koeʻuhi ko ha taha ʻeiki ʻi hono kakai, ke ne taʻemaʻa ai.
“ʻE ʻikai tenau tekefua honau ʻulu, pe tele hono potu tuliki ʻoe kava, pe fai ha tafatafaʻi ʻi honau sino.

Tenau māʻoniʻoni ki honau ʻOtua, kaeʻoua naʻa fakaongokoviʻi ʻae huafa ʻo honau ʻOtua: he ko e ngaahi feilaulau kia Sihova ʻoku ngaohi ʻi he afi, pea ʻoku nau ʻatu ʻae mā ʻa honau ʻOtua; ko ia ʻe māʻoniʻoni ai ʻakinautolu.
‌ʻE ʻikai tenau fakamaʻu mali mo ha fefine faʻa feʻauaki, pe ha taʻelotu; pea ʻoua naʻa nau maʻu ʻae fefine kuo tukuange mei hono mali: he ʻoku māʻoniʻoni ia ki hono ʻOtua.
Ko ia ke ke fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ia; he ʻoku ne ʻatu ʻae mā ʻa ho ʻOtua; ʻe māʻoniʻoni ia kiate koe: he ko au Sihova, ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ʻakimoutolu, ʻoku ou māʻoniʻoni.
Pea ko e ʻofefine ʻo ha taulaʻeiki, kapau ʻoku ne fakahalaʻi ʻe ia ia ʻi he fai feʻauaki, ʻoku ne fakahalaʻi ʻene tamai: ʻe tutu ʻaki ia ʻae afi.
“Pea ko ia ʻoku taulaʻeiki lahi ʻi hono ngaahi kāinga, ʻaia naʻe lingi ki hono ʻulu ʻae lolo ʻoe fakanofo, pea kuo fakatapui ke ʻai ʻae ngaahi kofu, ʻe ʻikai toʻo ʻe ia hono tatā, pe hae hono kofu;
Pea ʻe ʻikai te ne ʻalu ia ki ha sino ʻoku mate, pe fakahalaʻi ʻe ia ia koeʻuhi ko ʻene tamai, pe ko ʻene faʻē;
Pea ʻe ʻikai ʻalu ia kituaʻā ʻi he faletapu, pe fakahalaʻi ʻae faletapu ʻo hono ʻOtua; he ko e tatā ʻoe lolo tākai ʻo hono ʻOtua ʻoku ʻiate ia: Ko au ko Sihova.
Pea te ne fili ʻe ia hono uaifi ko e tāupoʻou.
Ko e fefine paea, pe ko e fefine fakamāvae, pe ko e taʻelotu, pe ko e feʻauaki, ko kinautolu ni ʻe ʻikai te ne fili: kae maʻu ʻe ia ha taʻahine mei hono kakai ko hono uaifi.
Pea ʻe ʻikai te ne fakahalaʻi ʻe ia hono hako ʻi he lotolotonga ʻo hono kakai: he ko au ko Sihova ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ia.”
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea kia ʻElone, ʻo pehē, “Ko ia ʻi ho hako ʻi honau toʻutangata kotoa pē, ʻoku ʻiate ia hano mele, ʻoua naʻa ʻunuʻunu mai ia ke ʻatu ʻae mā ʻa hono ʻOtua.
He ko e tangata ko ia ʻoku ai hano mele, ʻoua naʻa ʻunuʻunu mai ia: ko e tangata kui, pe ko e ketu, pe ko ia ʻoku ihu lafalafa, pe ai haʻane anga ʻoku kehe,
Pe ha tangata ʻoku veʻe fasi, pe nima fasi,
‌ʻAe tuʻa piko pe ko e kihi, pe hangatāmakia hono mata, pe ko e kamaa, pe ko e mongumangu, pe ko e tangapula.

‌ʻIlonga ʻae tangata ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻElone ko e taulaʻeiki ʻoku ʻiate ia ha mele, ke ʻoua naʻa ʻunuʻunu mai ia ke ʻatu kia Sihova ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi: ʻoku ʻiate ia hano mele; ʻe ʻikai ofi mai ia ke ʻatu ʻae mā ʻa hono ʻOtua.
‌ʻE kai ʻe ia ʻae mā ʻa hono ʻOtua, ʻio, ʻae māʻoniʻoni lahi, pea mo e māʻoniʻoni pe.

Ka koeʻuhi pe ʻe ʻikai te ne ʻalu ki he loto puipui, pe hoko ʻo ofi ki he feilaulauʻanga, koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻiate ia hano mele; ke ʻoua naʻa fakahalaʻi ʻe ia hoku ngaahi potu tapu: he ko au ko Sihova ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoni ʻakinautolu.”
Pea naʻe tala ia ʻe Mōsese kia ʻElone, pea ki hono ngaahi foha, pea ki he fānau kotoa pē ʻa ʻIsileli.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,

Lea kia ʻElone pea ki hono ngaahi foha, koeʻuhi kenau fakamavae ʻakinautolu mei he ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, pea ke “ʻOua naʻa nau fakahalaʻi hoku huafa māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ko ia ʻoku nau fakatapui kiate au: Ko au ko Sihova.

Tala kiate kinautolu, Ko ia ʻiate kimoutolu ʻi homou hako kotoa pē ʻi homou ngaahi toʻutangata, ʻoku ʻalu ki he ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni, ʻaia ʻoku fakatapui ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli kia Sihova, ka ʻoku ne taʻemaʻa, ʻe motuhi ʻae laumālie ko ia mei hoku ʻao: Ko au ko Sihova.

“Ko e tangata ko ia ʻi he hako ʻo ʻElone ʻoku kilia, pe mahaki ko e ʻau; ʻoua naʻa kai ia ʻi he ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni, kaeʻoua ke maʻa ia. Pea mo ia ʻoku ala ki ha meʻa taʻemaʻa ʻi he mate, pe ʻi ha tangata ʻoku ʻau noa hono mahaki;
Pe ha taha ʻoku ala ki ha meʻa totolo, ʻaia ʻe hoko ʻo taʻemaʻa ai, pe ʻi ha tangata ʻaia ʻe hoko ʻo pihia ai, ʻi he mahaki ʻoku taʻemaʻa ai ia;
Ko e tangata kuo ala ki ha meʻa pehē ʻe taʻemaʻa ia ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi, pea ʻe ʻikai kai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni, kaeʻoua ke kaukau hono sino ʻi he vai.
Pea ka tō ʻae laʻā, ʻe toki maʻa ia, pea kai ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni; he koeʻuhi ko ʻene meʻakai ia.
Ko ia ʻoku mate mahaki pe, pe ko ia kuo haehae ʻe he manu, ʻoua naʻa ne kai ia ke fakahala ai ia: Ko au ko Sihova.
“Ko ia kenau tauhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ni, telia naʻa nau halaia ai, pea mate ai, ʻo kapau ʻoku nau fakahalaʻi ia: Ko au ko Sihova ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ʻakinautolu.
“ʻE ʻikai kai ʻe ha muli ki he ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni: ko e ʻāunofo ʻae taulaʻeiki, pe ko e tamaioʻeiki unga ngāue, ʻe ʻikai kai ia ʻi he meʻa māʻoniʻoni.
Pea kapau ʻe fakatau ha tokotaha ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻaki ʻene paʻanga, ʻe ngofua ʻene kai ʻaʻana, pea mo ia kuo fānau ʻi hono fale: te na kai ʻi heʻene meʻakai.
Pea kapau ʻoku mali ʻae ʻofefine ʻoe taulaʻeiki mo e tangata kehe, ʻe ʻikai ngofua ʻa ʻene kai ʻaʻana ʻi he meʻa ʻatu ʻoe ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni.

Pea kapau ko e fefine paea ʻae ʻofefine ʻoe taulaʻeiki, pe kuo fakamāvaeʻi pea ʻikai haʻane tamasiʻi, pea kuo toe ʻomi ia ki he fale ʻo ʻene tamai, ʻo hangē ko ʻene kei siʻi, ʻe kai ia ʻi he meʻakai ʻa ʻene tamai: kaeʻoua naʻa kai ia ʻe ha muli.
“Pea kapau ʻe kai faainoa pe ʻe ha tangata ʻae meʻa māʻoniʻoni, te ne fakalahi ʻaki ia hono nima ʻoe vahe ʻo ia, pea ʻatu ia ki he taulaʻeiki fakataha mo e meʻa māʻoniʻoni.
Pea ʻe ʻikai tenau fakahalaʻi ʻae ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻaia ʻoku nau ʻatu kia Sihova:
Pe tuku ʻakinautolu ke fua ʻae hia ʻae fai hala, ʻi heʻenau kai ʻenau ngaahi meʻa māʻoniʻoni: he ko au ko Sihova ʻoku ou fakamāʻoniʻoniʻi ʻakinautolu.”
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,

Lea kia ʻElone, pea ki hono ngaahi foha, pea ki he fānau kotoa pē ʻa ʻIsileli, pea ke pehē kiate kinautolu, ʻilonga ʻae tangata ʻi he fale ʻo ʻIsileli, pe ʻi he ngaahi muli ʻi ʻIsileli, ʻoku loto ke ʻatu ʻene meʻaʻofa ʻi heʻene ngaahi fuakava, pea ki heʻene ngaahi meʻa ʻoku ʻatu loto ʻataʻatā pe, ʻaia ʻoku nau ʻatu kia Sihova ko e feilaulau tutu:
Ke mou ʻatu ʻo fai loto lelei pe, ʻae manu tangata taʻehanomele mei he fanga pulu pe ko e fanga sipi, pe ko e fanga kosi.
Ka ko ia ʻoku ai hano mele, ʻoua naʻa mou ʻatu ia; koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai leleiʻia ai ʻakimoutolu.

Pea ko ia ʻoku ne ʻatu kia Sihova ʻae feilaulau ʻoe ngaahi meʻa fakamelino ke fakahoko ʻaki ʻene fuakava, pea ko e meʻa ʻatu loto lelei ʻi he fanga pulu, pe ʻi he fanga sipi, ke haohaoa ia koeʻuhi ke maʻu lelei ia; ʻoua naʻa ʻi ai hano mele.

Ko e kui, pe ko e fasi, pe ko e mutu, pe ko e meʻa fufula, pe ko e kamaa, pe ko e mongumangu, ʻoua naʻa mou ʻatu mei ai kia Sihova, pe fai ʻaki ia ha feilaulau tutu ʻaki ʻae afi ki he funga feilaulauʻanga ʻo Sihova.
Ko e pulu pe ko e lami ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa kovi, pe ʻoku taʻehaohaoa ʻi ha meʻa ʻe taha, ʻe ngofua ke ʻatu ia ko e feilaulau loto ʻataʻatā ia: ka ʻe ʻikai maʻu lelei ia ʻi he fuakava.
‌ʻOua naʻa mou ʻatu kia Sihova ʻaia kuo fakavolu, pe kuo taʻomia, pe kuo mafesi, pe kuo mahifi; pea ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha feilaulau ʻaki ia ʻi homou fonua.
Pea ʻoua naʻa ke ʻatu ʻi he nima ʻo ha muli ʻae meʻakai ʻa homou ʻOtua ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ni; koeʻuhi ʻoku ʻi ai ʻenau kovi, pea ʻoku ʻi ai ʻae ngaahi mele: ʻe ʻikai ʻaonga ia maʻamoutolu.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
‌ʻOka fanauʻi ha pulu, pe ha sipi, pe ha kosi, tuku ia ke ʻaho fitu mo ʻene faʻē: pea mei he ʻaho valu ʻo fai ai pe ʻe maʻu lelei pe ia ko e feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova.
Pea kapau ko ha pulu fefine ia pe ha sipi fefine, ʻoua naʻa mou tāmateʻi ia mo hono ʻuhiki ʻi he ʻaho pe taha.
Pea ka mou ka loto ke ʻatu ha feilaulau fakafetaʻi kia Sihova, ʻatu ia ʻi he loto ʻataʻatā lelei pe.
‌ʻI he ʻaho pe ko ia ʻe kai ia ke ʻosi ʻoua naʻa mou tuku hono toe ki he ʻapongipongi; Ko au ko Sihova.
“Ko ia ke mou tauhi ai ʻeku ngaahi fekau, mo fai ki ai; Ko au ko Sihova.
Pea ʻoua naʻa mou fakahalaʻi hoku huafa māʻoniʻoni; kae ʻapasia kiate au ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli: Ko au ko Sihova ʻaia ʻoku ou fakatapui ʻakimoutolu;
Naʻaku ʻomi ʻakimoutolu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite, ke hoko ko homou ʻOtua: Ko au ko Sihova.”
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, Ko e ngaahi kātoanga kia Sihova, ʻaia te mou fakahā ko e ngaahi fakataha māʻoniʻoni, ʻio, ko ʻeku ngaahi kātoanga ʻaʻaku ia.

Ko e ʻaho ʻe ono ʻe fai ai ʻae ngāue: ka ko hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho ko e Sāpate mālōlō ia, ko e fakataha māʻoniʻoni; ʻoua naʻa mou fai ai ha ngāue ʻe taha; he ko e ʻaho tapu ia ʻo Sihova ʻi homou ngaahi fale kotoa pē.
Ko e ngaahi kātoanga eni ʻa Sihova, ʻio, ʻae ngaahi kātoanga māʻoniʻoni, ʻaia te mou fanongonongo ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahitaʻu.
‌ʻI he efiafi ʻo hono hongofulu ma fā ʻoe[ʻaho] ʻoe ʻuluaki māhina, ko e Lakaatu ʻo Sihova ia.
Pea ʻi hono hongofulu ma nima ʻoe ʻaho ʻi he māhina ko ia, ko e kātoanga kai mā taʻefakalēvani kia Sihova; ke mou kai mā taʻefakalēvani ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu.
Ke mou fai ʻae fakataha māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻuluaki ʻaho: ʻoua naʻa fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai.
Ka mou ʻatu ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu: ko hono fitu ʻoe ʻaho ko e kātoanga māʻoniʻoni; ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,

Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē kiate kinautolu, ʻOka mou ka hoko atu ki he fonua ʻoku ou foaki kiate kimoutolu, pea ʻoku mou tuʻusi hono ngaahi fua, te mou toki ʻomi ʻae faluku ʻe taha ʻoe ʻuluaki fua ʻo hoʻo ngoue ki he taulaʻeiki:
Pea ʻe taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ʻe ia ʻae faluku ʻoe koane ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova, ke maʻu ia koeʻuhi ko koe: ʻi he pongipongi ʻi he hili ʻae Sāpate ʻe taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki.
Pea te mou ʻatu ʻi he ʻaho ko ia ʻoku mou taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ʻae faluku ʻoe koane, ʻae lami tangata taʻehanomele ʻi hono ʻuluaki taʻu, ko e feilaulau tutu kia Sihova.

Pea ko e feilaulau meʻakai ʻo ia ko e oma ʻe ua ʻoe mahoaʻa lelei mo e lolo, ko e feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova, ko e meʻa namu kakala; pea ko e feilaulau inu ʻo ia ko e uaine, ko hono fā ʻoe vahe ʻoe hini.

Pea ʻe ʻikai te mou kai ʻae mā pe ko e uite tunu, pe ko e fua mata, kaeʻoua ke hokosia ʻae ʻaho ko ia ʻoku mou ʻomi ai ha feilaulau ki homou ʻOtua: ko e fekau fai maʻu ia ʻi homou ngaahi toʻutangata ʻi homou ngaahi nofoʻanga kotoa pē.
Pea ke mou lau kiate kimoutolu mei he pongipongi ʻi he hili ʻae Sāpate, mei he ʻaho naʻa mou ʻomi ai ʻae faluku ʻoe feilaulau ke taʻaloʻalo ʻaki; ʻe kātoa ʻae Sāpate ʻe fitu:
‌ʻIo, ʻo hoko mo e pongipongi ʻi he hili hono fitu ʻoe Sāpate ke mou lau ʻae ʻaho ʻe nimangofulu; pea ke mou ʻatu ʻae feilaulau foʻou ʻoe meʻakai kia Sihova.
Ke mou ʻomi mei homou ngaahi fale ʻae foʻi mā taʻaloʻalo ʻe ua ʻoe oma ʻe ua: ʻe ngaohi ʻaki ia ʻae mahoaʻa lelei; ʻe taʻo ia mo e lēvani; ko e ʻuluaki fua ia kia Sihova.

Pea ke mou ʻatu fakataha mo e mā ʻae lami ʻe fitu taʻehanaumele, ʻi he ʻuluaki taʻu, mo e pulu mui ʻe taha, mo e sipitangata ʻe ua: ko e feilaulau tutu ia kia Sihova, fakataha mo ʻenau ngaahi feilaulau meʻakai, mo e feilaulau inu, ʻio, ko e feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi, ko e meʻa namu kakala kia Sihova.
Pea ke mou feilaulau ʻaki ʻae ʻuhikiʻi kosi ʻe taha ko e feilaulau maʻae angahala, mo e lami ʻe ua ʻoe ʻuluaki taʻu ko e feilaulau fakamelino.
Pea ʻe taʻaloʻalo ʻaki ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki fakataha mo e mā ʻoe ʻuluaki fua, mo e ongo lami ko e feilaulau taʻaloʻalo ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova; ʻe māʻoniʻoni ia kia Sihova maʻae taulaʻeiki.

Pea ke mou fanongonongo ʻi he ʻaho pe ko ia, ke ʻiate kimoutolu ia ko e fakataha māʻoniʻoni; ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai: ko e fekau fai maʻu ia ʻi homou ngaahi fale nofoʻanga kotoa pē ʻi homou toʻutangata kotoa pē.

Pea ʻoka ke ka tuʻusi ʻae ngaahi fua ʻo ho fonua, ʻo ʻikai te ke fetuku ke ʻosi mei he ngaahi tuliki ʻo hoʻo ngoue ʻoka ke ka tuʻusi ia, pea ʻe ʻikai te ke tānaki ʻae toenga ʻo hoʻo fua: ka te ke tuku ia ki he masiva, pea ki he muli: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē, ʻI hono fitu ʻoe māhina, ʻi he ʻuluaki [ʻaho] ʻoe māhina, ʻe ʻiate kimoutolu ʻae Sāpate, ko e fakamanatu ʻoe ifi meʻa lea, ko e fakataha māʻoniʻoni.
‌ʻE ʻikai te mou fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai: ka te mou ʻatu ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,

‌ʻI hono hongofulu foki ʻoe [ʻaho] ʻo hono fitu ʻoe māhina ni ʻe ai ʻae ʻaho ʻoe fakalelei: ko e ʻaho ia ʻoe fakataha māʻoniʻoni kiate kimoutolu; pea ke mou fakamamahi homou laumālie, pea ʻatu ha feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova.
Pea ʻe ʻikai te mou fai ha ngāue ʻi he ʻaho ko ia: he ko e ʻaho ia ʻoe fakalelei, ke fai ai ʻae fakalelei maʻamoutolu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
He ko ia ʻoku ʻikai fakamamahiʻi ia ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, ʻe motuhi ia mei hono kakai.
Pea ko ia ʻe fai ha ngāue ʻi he ʻaho ko ia, te u tāmateʻi ia mei hono kakai.
‌ʻE ʻikai te mou fai ha momoʻi ngāue; ko e fekau fai maʻu ia ʻi homou ngaahi toʻutangata ʻi homou ngaahi nofoʻanga kotoa pē.
‌ʻE ʻiate kimoutolu ia ko e Sāpate ʻoe mālōlō, pea te mou fakamamahi homou laumālie: ʻi hono hiva ʻoe[ʻaho] ʻoe māhina ʻi he efiafi, mei he efiafi ʻo aʻu ki he efiafi, ke mou tauhi homou Sāpate.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē, Ko hono hongofulu ma nima ʻoe [ʻaho] ʻa hono fitu ʻoe māhina ni ʻe hoko ia ko e kātoanga kia Sihova ʻoe ngaahi fale fehikitaki, ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu.
‌ʻI he ʻuluaki ʻaho ke mou fai ʻae fakataha māʻoniʻoni; ʻoua naʻa mou fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai.

Ko e ʻaho ʻe fitu ke mou ʻatu ai ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova: ʻi hono valu ʻoe ʻaho ke mou fai ʻae fakataha māʻoniʻoni: pea te mou ʻatu ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova: ko e fakataha mamalu: pea ʻe ʻikai te mou fai ha ngāue faʻiteliha ʻi ai.

Ko e ngaahi kātoanga eni ʻa Sihova, ʻaia ke mou fakahā ko e ngaahi fakataha māʻoniʻoni, ke ʻatu ai ʻae feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova, ko e feilaulau tutu, mo e feilaulau meʻakai, mo e feilaulau meʻainu, taki taha pe ʻi hono ʻaho:
Kaeʻumaʻā foki ʻae ngaahi Sāpate ʻo Sihova, pea mo hoʻomou ngaahi foaki, mo hoʻomou ngaahi fuakava, mo e ngaahi feilaulau ʻoku fai loto lelei pe, ʻaia ʻoku mou foaki kia Sihova.

Pea ʻi hono hongofulu ma nima foki ʻoe ʻaho ʻi hono fitu ʻoe māhina, hili hoʻomou tānaki ʻae fua ʻoe fonua, ke mou fai ha kātoanga kia Sihova ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu: ko hono ʻuluaki ʻaho, ko e Sāpate ia, pea ko hono valu ʻoe ʻaho ʻe Sāpate mo ia.

Pea te mou fili ʻekimoutolu ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ʻoe ʻakau matamatalelei, ʻae ngaahi vaʻa ponga, mo e ngaahi vaʻa ʻoe ʻakau lalahi, mo e ngaahi uilou ʻoe vaitafe; pea te mou fiefia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ko homou ʻOtua ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu.
Pea ke mou tauhi ia ko e kātoanga kia Sihova ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu ʻi he taʻu. Ko e fekau fai maʻu ia ʻi homou ngaahi toʻutangata: ke mou fai ia ʻi hono fitu ʻoe māhina.
Ke mou nofo ʻi he ngaahi fale louʻakau ʻi he ʻaho ʻe fitu; ko kinautolu kotoa pē kuo fanauʻi ko e ʻIsileli ʻe nofo ia ʻi he fale louʻakau:

Koeʻuhi ke ʻilo ʻe homou ngaahi toʻutangata naʻaku puleʻi ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ke nofo ʻi he ngaahi fale fehikitaki, ʻi heʻeku ʻomi ʻakinautolu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Pea naʻe fakahā ʻe Mōsese ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻae ngaahi kātoanga ʻa Sihova.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Fekau ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, koeʻuhi kenau ʻomi kiate koe ʻae lolo ʻolive lelei kuo tuki ki he maama, koeʻuhi ke ulo lelei maʻuaipē ʻae maama.

‌ʻE teuteu ia ʻe ʻElone ʻituʻa ʻi he puipui ʻoe fuakava ʻi he fale fehikitaki ʻoe kakai, mei he efiafi ki he pongipongi ʻe fai maʻuaipē ia ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova; ko e fekau fai maʻu pe ia ʻi homou toʻutangata kotoa pē.
Ke te u maʻuaipē ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi foʻi maama ki he tuʻunga maama tapu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea ke toʻo ʻae mahoaʻa lelei, ʻo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae foʻi mā ʻe hongofulu ma ua: ʻe ʻai ʻae oma ʻe ua ʻi he foʻi mā pe taha.
Pea te ke fokotuʻu ia ʻi he ʻotu ʻe ua, ke taki ono ʻi he ʻotu pe taha, ki he palepale māʻoniʻoni ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova.
Pea te ke ʻai ki he ʻotu fakatouʻosi pe ʻae laipeno moʻonia, koeʻuhi ke ʻi he mā ia ko e meʻa fakamanatu, ʻio, ko e feilaulau kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi kia Sihova.
‌ʻE ʻai ia ʻo teuteu ʻi he ʻao ʻo Sihova ʻo fai maʻu pe ʻi he Sāpate kotoa pē, kuo toʻo ia mei he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi he fuakava ʻoku taʻengata.
Pea ʻe ʻia ʻElone ia mo hono ngaahi foha; pea kenau kai ia ʻi he potu māʻoniʻoni: he ko e meʻa māʻoniʻoni lahi kiate ia ʻi he ngaahi feilaulau kia Sihova kuo ngaohi ʻaki ʻae afi ʻi he fekau tuʻumaʻu.

Pea naʻe ʻalu kituaʻā mo e fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻae tama ʻae fefine ʻIsileli, ka ko ʻene tamai ko e tangata ʻIsipite; pea ko e tama ʻae fefine ʻIsileli, mo e tangata ʻIsileli, naʻa na fekuki fakataha ʻi he ʻapitanga:

Pea naʻe kape ʻae tama ʻae fefine ʻIsileli ki he huafa ʻo Sihova ʻo lea kovi. Pea naʻa nau ʻomi ia kia Mōsese, (pea ko e hingoa ʻo ʻene faʻē, ko Selomiti, ko e ʻofefine ʻo Tipili ʻi he faʻahinga ʻo Tani:)
Pea naʻa nau tuku haʻisia ia, ke ʻoua ke nau ʻilo ʻae finangalo ʻo Sihova ki ai.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
“Ko ia kuo kape, ʻomi ia kituaʻā mei he ʻapitanga; pea ko kinautolu kotoa pē naʻe fanongo ki ai ke hilifaki honau nima ki hono ʻulu, pea ke tolongaki ia ʻe he fakataha kotoa pē ʻaki ʻae maka.
Pea ke lea koe ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo pehē, Ko ia ʻoku kapeʻi hono ʻOtua ʻe fua ʻe ia ʻene angahala.

Pea ko ia ʻoku ne kapeʻi ʻae huafa ʻo Sihova, ko e moʻoni ʻe tāmateʻi ia, ʻe tolongaki ia ʻaki ʻae maka ʻe he kakai kotoa pē: ko e muli ia pe ko ia kuo tupu ʻi he fonua, ʻoka kapeʻi ʻe ia ʻae huafa ʻo Sihova ʻe tāmateʻi ia.
“Pea ko ia ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ha tangata ʻe tāmateʻi moʻoni ia.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ha manu ʻe totongi ke tatau ia; ko e manu ki he manu.
“Pea kapau ʻe fakameleʻi ʻe ha tangata hono kaungāʻapi ʻe fai kiate ia ʻo hangē ko ia kuo ne fai
Ko e lavea ki he lavea, ko e mata ki he mata, ko e nifo ki he nifo: ʻo hangē ko ʻene fakameleʻi ha tangata, ʻe pehē pe hono fai kiate ia.
Pea ko ia ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ha manu, ʻe ʻatu ke tatau ia: pea ko ia ʻoku ne tāmateʻi ha tangata, ʻe tāmateʻi ia.
Ke mou maʻu ʻae fono pe taha, ki he muli, mo ia ʻoku ʻi homou fonua: he ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.”

Pea naʻe lea ʻa Mōsese ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, koeʻuhi kenau ʻomi ʻaia naʻe kape kituaʻā mei he ʻapitanga, ʻo tolongaki ʻaki ia ʻae maka. Pea naʻe fai ʻe he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻo hangē ko e fekau ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese ʻi he moʻunga ko Sainai, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, mo ke pehē kiate kinautolu, ʻOka mou ka hoko atu ki he fonua ʻaia ʻoku ou foaki kiate kimoutolu, ʻe toki fai ai ʻe he fonua ʻae Sāpate kia Sihova.
Ko e taʻu ʻe ono ke ke tō ai hoʻo ngoue, mo e taʻu ʻe ono ke ke ʻauhani hoʻo ngoue vaine, ʻo tānaki hono fua;
Ka ko hono fitu ʻoe taʻu ko e Sāpate ia ke mālōlō ai ʻae fonua, ko e Sāpate ia kia Sihova: ʻoua naʻa ke tō ai hoʻo ngoue, pe ʻauhani hoʻo ngoue vaine.
Ko ia ʻoku tupu ʻiate ia pe ʻi he ngaahi fua ʻo hoʻo taʻu ʻoua naʻa ke tuʻusi, pe toli ʻae ngaahi kālepi ʻoe vaine taʻeʻauhani he ko e taʻu mālōlō ia ki ho fonua.
Pea ko e Sāpate ʻoe fonua ko e meʻakai ia maʻamoutolu; kiate koe, pea ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki, pea ki hoʻo kaunanga, pea ki hoʻo tamaioʻeiki unga ngāue, pea ki he muli ʻoku ʻāunofo kiate koe,
Pea ki hoʻo fanga manu lahi, pea ki hoʻo fanga manu ʻi ho fonua kotoa pē, ko ia kotoa pē ʻoku tupu ko e meʻakai ia kiate kinautolu.
Pea ke lau kiate koe ʻae Sāpate ʻe fitu ʻoe ngaahi taʻu; ko e taʻu ʻe fitu lau ʻe fitu; pea ko hono lau ʻoe Sāpate ʻe fitu ʻoe ngaahi taʻu ko e taʻu ʻe fāngofulu ma hiva.
Pea te ke toki fekau ke ifi ʻae meʻa lea ʻoe siupeli ʻi hono hongofulu ʻoe [ʻaho] ʻi hono fitu ʻoe māhina, ʻi he ʻaho ʻoe fakalelei ke mou fakaongo atu ʻae meʻa lea ʻi homou fonua kotoa pē.

Pea ke mou fakatapui hono nimangofulu ʻoe taʻu, ʻo fakahā ʻae huhuʻi ʻi he fonua kotoa pē ki hono kakai kotoa pē; ʻe ʻiate kimoutolu ia ko e siupeli: pea ʻe toe hoko ʻae tangata taki taha kotoa pē ki hono ʻapi, pea ʻe toe haʻu taki taha ʻae tangata ki hono fale.
Ko e nimangofulu taʻu ko ia ʻe ʻiate kimoutolu ia ko e siupeli: ʻoua naʻa mou tūtuuʻi, pe tuʻusi ʻaia ʻoku tupu ʻiate ia pe, pe tānaki mei he vaine ʻoku taʻeʻauhani.
He ko e siupeli ia; ʻe māʻoniʻoni ia kiate kimoutolu: te mou kai ʻa hono fua ʻo ia mei he ngoue pe.
Pea ʻi he taʻu ʻoe siupeli ni ʻe toe haʻu ʻae tangata taki taha kotoa pē ki hono tofiʻa,
Pea kapau ʻoku ke fakatau ha meʻa ki ho kaungāʻapi, pe fakatau ha meʻa meiate ia, ʻoua naʻa mou fefakamamahiʻaki ʻakimoutolu:
Ke ke fakatau mei ho kaungāʻapi ʻo fakatatau ki hono lau ʻoe taʻu ʻi he hili ʻae siupeli, pea te ne fakatau kiate koe ʻo fakatatau ki hono lau ʻoe taʻu ʻo hono ngaahi fua:

Te ke fakalahi ʻa hono totongi ʻo fakatatau mo hono lahi ʻoe taʻu, pea ke fakasiʻisiʻi hono totongi ʻo fakatatau ki hono siʻi ʻoe taʻu: he ʻoku ne fakatau ia kiate koe ʻo fakatatau ki hono lau ʻoe taʻu ʻo hono fua ʻo ia.
Ko ia ʻoua naʻa mou fefakamamahiʻaki ʻakimoutolu; ka ke manavahē ki ho ʻOtua; he ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
Ko ia ke mou fai ʻeku ngaahi fekau, pea tauhi ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, ʻo fai ki ai; pea te mou nofo malu pe ʻi he fonua.
Pea ʻe tupu ʻi he fonua hono fua, pea te mou kai ʻo mākona, ʻo nofo ʻi ai ʻi he fiemālie.
Pea kapau ʻoku mou pehē, Ko e hā te mau kai ʻi hono fitu ʻoe taʻu? Koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai te mau tūtuuʻi, pe tānaki ʻemau fua:
Teu toki fekau ʻeku tāpuaki kiate kimoutolu ʻi hono ono ʻoe taʻu, pea ʻe tupu ʻi ai ʻae fua ʻo feʻunga mo e taʻu ʻe tolu.
Pea te mou tūtuuʻi ʻi hono valu ʻoe taʻu, kae kai ʻae fua motuʻa ʻo aʻu ki hono hiva ʻoe taʻu: te mou kai ʻae meʻakai motuʻa kaeʻoua ke hoko ʻa hono toʻukai.
ʻE ʻikai fakatau ʻae fonua ʻo taʻengata: he ʻoku ʻoʻoku ʻae fonua; he ko e kau muli mo e ʻāunofo ʻakimoutolu kiate au.
Pea ʻi he fonua kotoa pē ʻoku mou maʻu te mou tuku ke huhuʻi ʻae fonua.
Kapau kuo fakaʻaʻau ʻo masiva ʻa ho kāinga, pea kuo ne fakatau ha potu ʻo hono ʻapi, pea kapau ʻe haʻu ha niʻihi ʻi hono kāinga ke huhuʻi ia, ke ne huhuʻi ai ʻaia naʻe fakatau ʻe hono kāinga.
Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai ʻi he tangata ha tokotaha ke huhuʻi ia, pea ʻoku faʻa huhuʻi ia ʻe ia pe;
Tuku ai ke ne lau ʻe ia ʻae ngaahi taʻu ʻo hono fakatau ʻo ia, pea ʻatu hono toe ʻo ia ki he tangata naʻa ne fakatau ia ki ai; koeʻuhi ke toe haʻu ia ki hono ʻapi.

Pea kapau ʻoku ʻikai mafai ʻe ia ke toe ʻomi ia kiate ia, pea ko e meʻa naʻe fakatau ʻe tuku pe ia ʻi he nima ʻo ia naʻa ne fakatau ia ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻoe siupeli: pea ʻi he siupeli ʻe tukuange ia, pea ʻe haʻu ia ki hono ʻapi.

Pea kapau ʻoku fakatau ʻe ha tangata ha fale nofoʻanga ʻi loto kolo ʻoku ai hano ʻā maka, ʻe ngofua ʻa ʻene huhuʻi ia ʻi he ʻikai ʻosi ʻae taʻu kotoa hili hono fakatau: ʻi he taʻu kotoa ʻe ngofua ʻa ʻene huhuʻi ia.

Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai huhuʻi ia ʻi he taʻu kātoa, pea ko e fale ko ia ʻoku ʻi he kolo ʻā maka ʻe ʻoʻona ia naʻa ne fakatau ia ʻo taʻengata ʻi hono ngaahi toʻutangata; ʻe ʻikai toe tukuange ia ʻi he siupeli.
Ka ko e ngaahi fale ʻi he ngaahi potu kakai ʻoku ʻikai hanau ʻā, ʻe lau ia fakataha mo e ngaahi ngoue ʻoe fonua: ʻe ngofua ke huhuʻi ia, pea ʻe tukuange ia ʻi he siupeli.
Ka ko e ngaahi potu nofoʻanga ʻoe kau Livai, mo e ngaahi fale ʻi he ngaahi potu nofoʻanga ʻo honau ʻapi, ʻe ngofua ki he kau Livai, ke huhuʻi ia ʻi he kuonga kotoa pē.

Pea kapau ʻoku fakatau ʻe ha tangata mei he kau Livai, pea ko e fale naʻe fakatau, mo e potu kakai ʻo hono ʻapi, ʻe tukuange ia ʻi he siupeli: he ko e ngaahi fale ʻoe ngaahi potu kakai ʻoe kau Livai, ko honau ʻapi ia ʻi he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli.
Ka ko e ngoue ʻoku hoko ʻo ofi mo honau ngaahi potu kakai, ʻe ʻikai fakatau ia: he ko honau tofiʻa tuʻumaʻu ia.
Pea kapau kuo hoko ʻo masiva ʻa ho kāinga, pea kuo vaivai ia; pea te ke tokoni ia; neongo pe ko e muli ia pe ko ha ʻāunofo kiate koe; koeʻuhi ke ne moʻui ai mo koe.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke toʻo ha totongi ʻiate ia, pe hano tupu; ka ke manavahē ki he ʻOtua; koeʻuhi ke moʻui ho kāinga mo koe.
‌ʻOua naʻa ke ʻatu hoʻo koloa kiate ia ke maʻu ai ʻae totongi, pe nō hoʻo meʻakai ke maʻu ai hono tupu.
Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua, kuo u ʻomi ʻakimoutolu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite, ke foaki kiate kimoutolu ʻae fonua ko Kēnani, pea ke u hoko ko homou ʻOtua.
Pea kapau kuo hoko ʻo masiva ho kāinga ʻoku nofo ofi kiate koe, pea fakatau ʻe ia ia kiate koe: ʻoua naʻa ke fakapōpulaʻi ia ke fai ʻo hangē ha hopoate;
Ka ʻe ʻiate koe ia ʻo hangē ha tamaioʻeiki ʻoku ngāue ki ha totongi, mo e ʻāunofo, pea te ne ʻiate koe ko e tauhi ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻoe siupeli:
Pea ʻe toki ʻalu ia ʻiate koe, ʻaia mo ʻene fānau mo ia, pea ʻe toe hoko atu ia ki hono kāinga, pea ʻe hoko ki he ʻapi ʻo ʻene ngaahi tamai.
He ko ʻeku kau tamaioʻeiki ʻakinautolu, ʻaia naʻaku ʻomi mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite: ʻoua naʻa fakatau ʻakinautolu ke fakapōpulaʻi.
‌ʻE ʻikai te ke puleʻi ʻakinautolu ʻi he mālohi lahi; ka ke manavahē ki ho ʻOtua.
Ko hoʻo kau tamaioʻeiki mo hoʻo kau kaunanga ʻaia te ke maʻu, ʻe maʻu ia mei he kakai taʻelotu ʻoku nofo takatakai ʻiate koe; ke mou fakatau ʻiate kinautolu ʻae kau tamaioʻeiki mo e kau kaunanga.

Pea koeʻuhi ko e fānau ʻae kau muli ʻoku ʻāunofo ʻiate kimoutolu, te mou fakatau ʻiate kinautolu, pea ʻi honau ngaahi faʻahinga ʻoku ʻiate kimoutolu, ʻaia naʻa nau fakatupu ʻi homou fonua: pea ko homou kakai ʻakinautolu.

Pea ke mou maʻu ʻakinautolu ko e kakai ki hoʻomou fānau ʻoku muimui ʻiate kimoutolu, kenau maʻu ʻakinautolu ko honau kakai; ko hoʻomou kau tamaioʻeiki ʻo taʻengata; ka ʻe ʻikai te mou pule mālohi ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ko homou kāinga, ko e taha ki he taha.

Pea kapau ʻe fakaʻaʻau ʻo koloaʻia ha ʻāunofo, pe ha muli ʻoku nofo ofi kiate koe, pea fakaʻaʻau ʻo masiva ho kāinga ʻoku nofo ofi kiate ia, ʻo ne fakatau ia ki he muli pe ko e ʻāunofo ʻoku nofo ʻāunofo ofi kiate ia, pe ki ha tokotaha ʻi he hako ʻoe muli:
Hili hono fakatau ia ʻoku ngofua ke huhuʻi ia: ʻoku ngofua ke huhuʻi ia ʻe ha tokotaha ʻi hono kāinga.
‌ʻE ngofua ke huhuʻi ia ʻe he tokoua ʻo ʻene tamai, pe ko e foha ʻoʻona, pe huhuʻi ia ʻe ha tokotaha ʻoku kāinga ofi kiate ia ʻi hono kāinga; pea kapau ʻoku ne mafai, ke huhuʻi ia ʻe ia pe.

Pea te ne lau kiate ia naʻa ne fakatau ia ʻo fai mei he taʻu naʻe fakatau ai ia kiate ia ʻo hoko ki he taʻu ʻoe siupeli: pea ko e totongi ʻoe fakatau ʻe fakatatau ki hono lau ʻoe taʻu, ʻe fakatatau ia kiate ia mo e ngāue ʻae tamaioʻeiki ʻoku totongi.
Kapau ʻoku toe lahi ʻae taʻu kimui, ʻe toe ʻatu ʻe ia ʻo fakatatau ki ai ʻae koloa ʻo hono huhuʻi mei he koloa naʻe fakatauʻaki ia.
Pea kapau ʻoku toe siʻi pe ʻae taʻu ki he siupeli, pea ʻe lau ia ki ai mo ia, pea ʻe toe ʻatu kiate ia ʻo fakatatau ki hono taʻu ʻae totongi ʻo hono huhuʻi.
Pea ʻe ʻiate ia ia ʻo hangē ha tamaioʻeiki ngāue ʻoku totongi ʻi he taʻu taki taha; pea ʻe ʻikai puleʻi mālohi ia kiate ia ʻi ho ʻao.
Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai huhuʻi ia ʻi he ngaahi taʻu ko ia, pea ʻe toki tukuange ia ʻi he taʻu ʻoe siupeli, ʻa ia, mo ʻene fānau mo ia.
He ko e kau tamaioʻeiki kiate au ʻae fānau ʻa ʻIsileli; ko ʻeku kau tamaioʻeiki ʻakinautolu, ʻaia kuo u ʻomi mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite: Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.

“E ʻikai te mou ngaohi hamou ʻotua loi, pe ha fakatātā kuo tongitongi, pea ʻoua naʻa mou fokotuʻu hake ha meʻa fakatātā ke tuʻu, pea ʻe ʻikai te mou fokotuʻu hake ha fakatātā maka ʻi homou fonua, ke punou hifo ki ai: he ko au Sihova ko homou ʻOtua.
“Ke mou tauhi hoku ngaahi Sāpate, pea fai fakaʻapaʻapa ki hoku faletapu: Ko au ko Sihova.
“Kapau ʻoku mou ʻalu ʻi heʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni, pea tauhi ʻeku ngaahi fekau, pea fai ki ai;
Te u tuku ai kiate kimoutolu ʻae ʻuha ʻi hono faʻahitaʻu lelei, pea ʻe tupu ʻi he fonua ʻa hono fua, pea ʻe tupu mei he ngaahi ʻakau ʻoe ngoue honau ngaahi fua.
Pea ʻe hoko atu homou kuonga haha ki he tataʻo ʻoe vaine, pea ko e tataʻo vaine ʻe hoko atu ia ki he tūtuuʻi: pea te mou kai hoʻomou mā pea mākona, pea nofo fiemālie pe ʻi homou fonua.

Pea te u foaki ʻae melino ki he fonua, pea te mou tokoto hifo, pea ʻe ʻikai fakamanavahēʻi ʻakimoutolu ʻe ha tokotaha: pea te u fakaseʻeseʻe ʻae fanga manu kovi mei he fonua, pea ʻe ʻikai ʻalu ʻae heletā ʻo ʻasi ʻi homou fonua.
Pea te mou tuli homou ngaahi fili, pea tenau tō ʻi he heletā ʻi homou ʻao.
Pea ʻe tuli ʻe homou toko nima ʻae toko teau, pea ko e toko teau ʻomoutolu ʻe hola ai ʻae toko mano: pea ʻe hinga homou ngaahi fili ʻi homou ʻao ʻi he heletā.
He teu tokanga kiate kimoutolu, ʻo tāpuaki ʻakimoutolu, ʻo fakatokolahi ʻakimoutolu, ʻo fakatuʻumaʻu ʻeku fuakava mo kimoutolu.
Pea te mou kai ʻae meʻa motuʻa, pea ʻomi ʻae meʻa motuʻa koeʻuhi ko e meʻa foʻou.
Pea te u fokotuʻu hoku fale fehikitaki ʻiate kimoutolu: pea ʻe ʻikai fehiʻa hoku laumālie kiate kimoutolu.
Pea te u ʻeveʻeva ʻiate kimoutolu, pea ko homou ʻOtua au, pea te mou hoko ko hoku kakai.

Ko au ko Sihova ko homou ʻOtua, ʻaia naʻe ʻomi ʻakimoutolu mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite, koeʻuhi ke ʻoua naʻa mou nofo pōpula kiate kinautolu; pea naʻaku fesiʻi ʻae noʻo ʻo hoʻomou haʻamonga, ʻo ngaohi ʻakimoutolu ke mou ʻalu totonu.
“Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou tokanga kiate au, pea ʻikai fai ʻae ngaahi fekau ni;
Pea kapau te mou liʻaki ʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni ni, pea kapau ʻe fehiʻa homou laumālie ki heʻeku ngaahi fakamaau, pea ʻikai te mou fai ʻeku ngaahi fekau kotoa pē, ka mou liʻaki ʻeku fuakava:

Ko au foki te u fai eni kiate kimoutolu; Te u tuku kiate kimoutolu ʻae fakailifia, mo e fakaʻauʻausino, mo e pupuke vela, ʻaia ʻe fakakui ai ho mata, pea ne langaʻi ʻae mamahi ʻi loto: pea te mou tūtuuʻi taʻeʻaonga hoʻomou ngaahi tenga, koeʻuhi ʻe kai ia ʻe homou ngaahi fili.

Pea te u sio fakafulofula kiate kimoutolu, pea ʻe tāmateʻi ʻakimoutolu ʻi he ʻao ʻo homou ngaahi fili: ʻe pule kiate kimoutolu ʻakinautolu ʻoku fehiʻa kiate kimoutolu; pea te mou hola ka ʻoku ʻikai tuli ʻakimoutolu ʻe ha tokotaha.
Pea kapau te mou liʻaki kotoa pē ia, ʻo ʻikai siʻi tokanga kiate au, pea te u toki tautea ʻakimoutolu ke tā tuʻo fitu ʻi hoʻomou ngaahi angahala.
Pea te u fesiʻi ʻae laukau ʻo homou mālohi; pea te u ngaohi homou langi ke hangē ko e ukamea, mo homou kelekele ke hangē ko e palasa:
Pea ʻe fakaʻosi taʻeʻaonga homou mālohi: koeʻuhi ʻe ʻikai tuku hake ʻe he fonua hono tupu, pea ʻe ʻikai tupu ʻi he ngaahi ʻakau ʻoe fonua honau fua.
“Pea kapau te mou ʻalu kehe pe, pea ʻikai tokanga kiate au; te u ʻomi kiate kimoutolu ʻae mamahi ke tā tuʻo fitu ʻo fakatatau mo hoʻomou ngaahi angahala.

Pea te u ʻomi ʻae ngaahi manu fekai kiate kimoutolu, ʻaia ʻe kaihaʻasi hoʻomou fānau meiate kimoutolu, pea fakaʻauha hoʻomou fanga manu, ʻo fakatokosiʻi ʻakimoutolu; pea ʻe vaoa homou ngaahi hala motuʻa.
“Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou tui kiate au ʻi he ngaahi meʻa ni ʻo liliu ai, ka mou angatuʻu kiate au;
Pehē te u ʻalu hake foki kiate kimoutolu, pea te u tautea ʻakimoutolu ke tā tuʻo fitu ʻi hoʻomou ngaahi angahala.

Pea te u ʻomi ʻae heletā kiate kimoutolu, ʻaia te ne totongi kiate kimoutolu ʻi hono maumauʻi ʻo ʻeku fuakava: pea ka mou ka kātoa fakataha ʻi hoʻomou ngaahi kolo, te u fekau ʻae mahaki lahi kiate kimoutolu; pea ʻe tukuange ʻakimoutolu ki he nima ʻoe fili.

Pea hili ʻeku fesiʻi ʻae tokotoko ʻo hoʻomou mā, ko e kau fefine ʻe toko hongofulu tenau taʻo hoʻomou mā ʻi he ngotoʻumu pe taha, pea tenau toe ʻatu fakatuhotuha pe hoʻomou mā kiate kimoutolu: pea te mou kai, kae ʻikai mākona.
“Pea kapau ʻe ʻikai te mou tui kiate au neongo ʻa ʻeku fai eni kotoa pē, ka mou fai kehe pe kiate au:
Pea te u toki ʻalu kehe pe au ʻiate kimoutolu ʻi he houhau lahi: pea ko au, ʻio, ko au te u tautea ʻakimoutolu ke tā tuʻo fitu ʻi hoʻomou ngaahi angahala.
Pea te mou kai ʻae sino ʻo homou ngaahi foha, mo e sino ʻo homou ngaahi ʻofefine te mou kai.

Pea te u maumauʻi homou ngaahi potu māʻolunga, pea tā hifo hoʻomou ngaahi meʻa fakatātā, ʻo laku homou ngaahi ʻangaʻanga ki he ʻangaʻanga ʻo homou ngaahi ʻotua loi, pea te u fakaliliʻa kiate kimoutolu.
Pea te u ngaohi hoʻomou ngaahi kolo ke lala, pea te u tuku liʻaki pe homou ngaahi faletapu, pea ʻe ʻikai te u nanamu ki he namu kakala ʻo hoʻomou meʻa namu kakala.
Pea te u fakalala ʻae fonua; pea ko homou ngaahi fili ʻaia ʻoku nofo ai tenau ofo ki ai.
Pea te u fakahēʻi ʻakimoutolu ki he ngaahi fonua taʻelotu, pea teu toho ʻae heletā ke tuli ʻaki ʻakimoutolu: pea ʻe lala homou fonua, pea ʻe liʻaki homou ngaahi kolo.
Pea ʻe toki maʻu mālie pe ʻe he fonua hono ngaahi Sāpate, lolotonga ʻa ʻene lala, ka ʻoku mou ʻi he fonua ʻo homou fili ʻakimoutolu; ʻio, ʻe toki mālōlō ʻae fonua, pea maʻu pe hono ngaahi Sāpate.
Lolotonga hono tuku liʻaki ia ʻe mālōlō; koeʻuhi naʻe ʻikai mālōlō ia ʻi homou ngaahi Sāpate, lolotonga ʻa hoʻomou nofo ki ai.

“Pea kiate kinautolu ʻoku moʻui mo toe, ʻiate kimoutolu te u tuku ʻae vaivai ki honau loto ʻi he ngaahi fonua ʻo honau fili; pea ko e mumuhu ʻoe louʻakau vilingia te ne tulia ʻakinautolu; pea tenau hola ʻo hangē ko e hola mei he heletā; pea tenau hinga ʻi he ʻikai tuli ʻakinautolu ʻe ha tokotaha.

Pea tenau tō ʻo fetaʻotaʻomi pe ʻakinautolu, ʻo hangē ko e tō ʻi he ʻao ʻoe heletā, ka ʻoku ʻikai ha tokotaha ʻoku tulia ʻakinautolu: pea ʻe ʻikai te mou maʻu ha mālohi ke tuʻu ʻi he ʻao ʻo homou fili:
Pea te mou ʻauha ʻi he ngaahi fonua taʻelotu, pea ko e fonua ʻo homou ngaahi fili te ne kai ʻo ʻosi ʻakimoutolu.
Pea ko kinautolu ʻoku toe ʻiate kimoutolu tenau fakaʻaʻau ʻo ʻosi ʻi heʻenau hia ʻi he fonua ʻo homou fili: pea ʻi he hia ʻa ʻenau ngaahi tamai foki tenau fakaʻaʻau ʻo mole ai.
“Kapau tenau vete ʻenau ngaahi hia, pea mo e hia ʻa ʻenau ngaahi tamai, mo ʻenau ngaahi fai hala ʻaia kuo nau angahala ai kiate au, pea pehē mai foki, kuo nau ʻalu ʻo angatuʻu kiate au;

Pea kuo u ʻalu ʻo fai kehe kiate kinautolu, pea kuo u ʻomi ʻakinautolu ki he fonua ʻo honau fili; kapau kuo toki fakavaivai ʻa honau loto taʻekamu, pea nau maʻu loto lelei ʻae tautea ʻo ʻenau ngaahi hia:
Pehē te u manatu ai ki heʻeku fuakava kia Sēkope, pea mo ʻeku fuakava mo ʻAisake, pea mo ʻeku fuakava foki mo ʻEpalahame te u manatuʻi; pea te u manatuʻi ʻae fonua.

‌ʻE tuku liʻaki pe foki ʻae fonua ʻekinautolu, pea te ne maʻu mālie hono ngaahi Sāpate, ʻi heʻene tuku liʻaki pe ʻekinautolu: pea tenau tali lelei ʻae tautea ʻo ʻenau hia: koeʻuhi, ʻio, ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau liʻaki ʻeku ngaahi fono, pea ko e meʻa ʻi heʻenau fehiʻa ki heʻeku ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni.

Ka neongo ʻa eni kotoa pē, ʻoka nau ka ʻi he fonua ʻo honau fili, ʻe ʻikai te u liʻaki ʻakinautolu, pea ʻe ʻikai te u fehiʻa kiate kinautolu, ke fakaʻosi ʻaupito ʻakinautolu, pea ke liʻaki ʻeku fuakava mo kinautolu: he ko au ko Sihova ko honau ʻOtua.

Ka te u manatu koeʻuhi ko kinautolu, ki he fuakava ʻa ʻenau ʻuluaki mātuʻa, ʻaia naʻaku ʻomi mei he fonua ko ʻIsipite ʻi he ʻao ʻoe kakai taʻelotu, koeʻuhi ke u hoko ai ko honau ʻOtua: Ko au ko Sihova.”
Ko eni ʻae ngaahi tuʻutuʻuni mo e ngaahi fono, mo e ngaahi fekau, ʻaia naʻe fokotuʻu ʻe Sihova ke kau kiate ia mo e fānau ʻa ʻIsileli ʻi he moʻunga ko Sainai ʻi he nima ʻo Mōsese.
Pea naʻe folofola ʻa Sihova kia Mōsese, ʻo pehē,
Lea ki he fānau ʻa ʻIsileli, ʻo tala kiate kinautolu, ʻOka fai ʻe ha tangata ha fuakava mamafa, ʻe ʻa Sihova ʻae tatau ʻoe meʻa ko ia te ke lau ʻe koe.

Pea ko hoʻo fakatatau ʻae tangata mei he taʻu ʻe uofulu ʻo ʻene motuʻa ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe onongofulu ʻo ʻene motuʻa, ʻio, ko hoʻo fakatatau ko e sikeli siliva ʻe fitungofulu, ʻo fakatatau ki he sikeli ʻoe faletapu.
Pea kapau ko e fefine ia, ko hoʻo fakatatau, ko e sikeli ʻe tolungofulu.
Pea kapau ko e taʻu ʻe nima ʻene motuʻa ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe uofulu, pea ko hoʻo fakatatau ki he tangata ko e sikeli ʻe uofulu, pea ki he fefine ko e sikeli ʻe hongofulu.

Pea kapau ko e māhina pe taha ʻene motuʻa ʻo aʻu ki he taʻu ʻe nima ʻene motuʻa, pea ko hoʻo fakatatau ki he tangata ko e sikeli siliva ʻe nima, pea ko hoʻo fakatatau ki he fefine ko e sikeli siliva ʻe tolu.
Pea kapau ʻoku onongofulu taʻu mo e taʻu niʻihi ʻene motuʻa; kapau ko e tangata, ko hoʻo fakatatau ki ai ko e sikeli ʻe hongofulu ma nima, pea ki he fefine ko e sikeli ʻe hongofulu.

Pea kapau ʻoku masiva ʻaupito ia ʻi he meʻa kuo ke lau, pea te ne fakahā ia ʻi he ʻao ʻoe taulaʻeiki, pea ʻe fakatatau ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki; pea ke fai ʻe he taulaʻeiki ʻi heʻene fakatatau, ʻo taau mo hono mafai ʻo ia ʻaia naʻa ne fuakava.
Pea kapau ko e manu, ʻaia ʻoku ʻomi ʻe he kakai ʻo ʻatu kia Sihova, ko ia kotoa pē ʻoku foaki ʻe ha tangata ʻi he meʻa pehē kia Sihova ʻe tapu ia.
‌ʻE ʻikai te ne fakakehe ia, pe fetongi ia, ʻae lelei ki he kovi, pe ha kovi ki he lelei: pea kapau ʻoku ne fetongi ʻae manu ʻaki ʻae manu, pea ko ia mo ia naʻe fetongi ʻaki ia ʻe fakatou tapu ia.
Pea kapau ko e manu taʻemaʻa ia, ʻaia ʻoku ʻikai tenau fai ʻaki ha feilaulau kia Sihova, te ne toki ʻatu ʻae manu ʻi he ʻao ʻoe taulaʻeiki:
Pea ke fakatatau ia ʻe he taulaʻeiki, pe ʻoku lelei pe ʻoku kovi: pea hangē ko hoʻo fakatatau ʻe koe ʻoku taulaʻeiki ko ia pe ʻe fai.
